Title: Infrastructure Construction Manager
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Infrastructure Construction Manager** to lead and oversee all on-site execution activities for large-scale civil and utility infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will manage site teams, subcontractors, equipment, and daily operations to ensure works—such as earthworks, roads, drainage, and wet/dry utilities—are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in strict compliance with quality and regulatory standards.Key Responsibilities

* **Site Execution & Leadership:** Direct and coordinate daily site construction operations across multiple work fronts, managing site engineers, superintendents, foremen, and subcontractors.
* **Schedule & Progress Control:** Translate master project schedules into short-term look-ahead plans, track daily productivity, identify bottlenecks, and implement recovery plans to meet key milestones.
* **Health, Safety & Environment (HSE):** Enforce strict site HSE policies, conduct safety walks, ensure Permit-to-Work (PTW) compliance, and promote a zero-incident culture across all site personnel.
* **Quality Assurance & Control (QA/QC):** Ensure all construction activities adhere to approved method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), project specifications, and engineering drawings.
* **Subcontractor & Resource Management:** Supervise subcontractor performance, optimize labor and heavy machinery allocation, and coordinate timely material deliveries to prevent site downtime.
* **Design & Technical Resolution:** Collaborate closely with engineering and technical teams to resolve field clashes, review shop drawings, and manage Requests for Information (RFIs).
* **Authority & Utility Coordination:** Coordinate on-site inspections, utility diversions, tie-ins, and statutory approvals with local authorities and service providers.
* **Testing, Commissioning & Handover:** Oversee pre-commissioning, hydrostatic/pressure testing, snagging rectification, and final site handover to the client or operations team.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering field.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 10–15 years of proven site management experience on major infrastructure projects (roads, highways, bridges, sewerage, stormwater, potable water, and power/telecom networks).
* **Certifications:** PMP, NEBOSH/IOSH, or relevant local engineering registration/society membership is preferred.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong ability to read and interpret complex civil/utility drawings, familiarity with Primavera P6/MS Project schedules, and solid knowledge of construction methodologies.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with local authority codes, utility standards, and traffic management/diversion protocols.
* **Core Competencies:** Decisive field leadership, strong conflict resolution, crisis management, and clear communication across technical and non-technical teams.

This person leads joint business planning built around clear revenue targets, negotiates and manages contracts that protect and grow T-Mobile's position, and carries full accountability for revenue growth generated through the partnership. **Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Executive Relationship & Revenue Ownership: Serve as the primary executive-level point of contact for one or two assigned Technology Services Distributors (TSDs), using that relationship to unlock and accelerate revenue growth across the partnership. Develop and drive joint annual and quarterly business plans with the TSD, aligning goals, growth targets, and investment priorities. Own and report on revenue performance sourced through the partnership.
* Strategic Initiatives: Conceive, build, and execute go-to-market strategies and strategic initiatives with the TSD(s) that expand T-Mobile's share of TSD revenue, optimizing offers, programs, and investment to meet growth targets.

* 7+ years of executive-level relationship management, with a track record of building credibility and influence with senior partner leadership
* 7+ years of contract negotiation and management experience, including structuring agreements that drive measurable revenue outcomes
* 7+ years of direct accountability for revenue growth or quota attainment, ideally through a partner or channel relationship
* 7+ years of joint business planning experience, developing and executing strategic initiatives with partner organizations that translate into incremental bookings

**Preferred Experience:**

* Executive Communication: Comfortable presenting and building trust with senior leadership at the partner organization.

Description:
Job Description
  
  
Director, Technology Procurement – Category Lead, IT Hardware, Infrastructure & Telecom
  
  
The Director, Technology Procurement – Category Lead, IT Hardware, Infrastructure & Telecom leads global strategic sourcing across end-user devices, data center and network infrastructure, and telecom and mobility services. Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Technology Procurement, this role partners closely with IT leaders across Infrastructure, Workplace Technology, Network & Telecom, and other relevant areas to align category strategies with global business and technology priorities.
  
As our Company's IT organization continues its multi-year transformation, including cloud services, hybrid infrastructure modernization, and data and analytics capabilities, this role will lead cross-functional sourcing activities and support effective decision-making across cost, supply continuity, lifecycle management, sustainability, and business requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Category Strategy: Develop and implement global category strategies for IT Hardware, including laptops, desktops, mobile devices and peripherals; Infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking, data center and colocation, and hybrid cloud infrastructure; and Telecom, including voice, data/WAN, mobility and carrier services.
* Supplier Management: Manage strategic relationships with OEMs, resellers, carriers, and managed-service providers, including commercial, performance, and service-level considerations. Working knowledge of Software and IT Services categories is beneficial.
* RFP Management: Lead sourcing activities, including RFIs, RFQs and RFPs, using appropriate e-Sourcing tools and processes to support supplier evaluation and selection.
* Contract Negotiation: Lead negotiations for complex hardware, infrastructure and telecom agreements, including volume pricing, leasing and device-as-a-service models, maintenance and support, and carrier service-level terms.
* Cost Management: Identify and deliver procurement value through demand management, standardization and total cost of ownership optimization, and track progress through established Procurement processes and systems.
* Supply Continuity & Risk: Monitor market conditions, supply-chain constraints, geopolitical developments and supplier risks, and develop appropriate mitigation strategies to support continuity of critical hardware, infrastructure and network services.
* Lifecycle & Sustainability: Support asset lifecycle, refresh and IT asset disposition strategies aligned with our Company's sustainability and circularity objectives.
* Inclusive Sourcing: Support inclusive sourcing strategies and engagement with diverse suppliers in the US and globally.

Primary Activities
  
  

* Lead competitive sourcing events and supplier selection and negotiation processes across hardware, infrastructure and telecom categories.
* Build strong relationships with IT and business stakeholders to understand business requirements and technology roadmaps.
* Monitor relevant market developments, pricing and emerging technologies, including AI-ready infrastructure, SD-WAN, 5G and device-as-a-service, and incorporate relevant insights into category strategies.
* Apply effective change-management practices and demonstrate our Company's Leadership Behaviors.
* Support alignment with global procurement strategies and continuous improvement in supplier value management.

Qualifications
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Finance, Business or a related field; advanced degree or MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in IT procurement, with experience across IT hardware, infrastructure, data center, network and/or telecom categories.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including experience developing and supporting teams.
* Strong understanding of the hardware OEM, reseller and carrier landscape, data center and colocation models, and hybrid/cloud infrastructure commercial models.

Skills and Abilities
  
  

* Strong project management and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex and high-visibility initiatives.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, including experience with total cost of ownership and should-cost analysis and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a global, matrixed organization and across different cultures.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across global locations and time zones, including colleagues based in the US, with flexibility for occasional time-zone overlap as business needs require.

Title: Program Manager
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting and Software Development
Description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**This role is open to candidates based in either Dubai or Riyadh.**
**Role Summary**
The Program Manager is responsible for leading Genesys’ largest, most complex and strategically important customer engagements while providing governance and delivery oversight across the regional project portfolio.
  
  
The Program Manager serves as the senior point of accountability and escalation for project delivery within the region. The role ensures that engagements are delivered to consistent Genesys standards, achieve the customer’s intended business outcomes, maintain strong customer and executive confidence, and meet Genesys revenue, margin and financial-performance objectives.
  
  
Working across Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Product, Support, partners and customer leadership teams, the Program Manager creates the alignment, governance and executive focus required to deliver complex transformation programs successfully.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic and Mega-Engagement Leadership**

* Lead Genesys’ largest and most complex customer programs from initiation through deployment, adoption, value realization and transition to ongoing Customer Success.
* Establish the overall program vision, governance model, delivery strategy, integrated roadmap and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate multiple projects, workstreams, countries, partners and stakeholder groups as one integrated program.
* Ensure that scope, solution design, delivery plans and priorities remain aligned with the customer’s strategic and operational objectives.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with customer sponsors and provide clear, outcome-oriented program reporting.
* Drive timely decisions, remove cross-functional obstacles and maintain momentum across the entire engagement.
* Ensure effective transition from sales to delivery and from implementation to adoption and ongoing success.

**Regional Delivery Governance**

* Provide oversight of the regional project portfolio, with particular focus on strategic, high-value, high-risk or escalated engagements.
* Establish and enforce consistent delivery standards, governance practices, project controls and quality expectations.
* Conduct regular portfolio and project-health reviews covering scope, schedule, financials, staffing, dependencies, risks, customer sentiment and business outcomes.
* Ensure project teams maintain effective governance artifacts, including integrated plans, RAID logs, decision records, financial forecasts, status reports and escalation plans.
* Identify systemic delivery risks, capability gaps and recurring project issues, and lead regional improvement initiatives.
* Promote the consistent application and continuous improvement of Genesys delivery methodologies and best practices.
* Coach Project Managers, Delivery Managers and project leads on program governance, executive communication, risk management and customer engagement.

**Escalation and Risk Management**

* Act as the senior point of escalation for project-delivery issues across the region.
* Establish clear escalation paths, ownership, decision rights and recovery actions.
* Intervene early when project conditions could affect customer objectives, delivery commitments, revenue, margin or customer confidence.
* Lead recovery planning for critical projects, bringing together the appropriate Genesys, partner and customer stakeholders.
* Escalate product, support, resource or commercial dependencies to the relevant leadership teams and drive them through resolution.
* Ensure material risks and issues are communicated transparently, with clearly defined business impact, accountable owners and target resolution dates.
* Balance immediate issue resolution with protection of the long-term customer relationship.

**Customer Business-Value Realization**

* Translate customer strategic priorities into measurable program objectives, operational KPIs and value-realization plans.
* Ensure every strategic engagement has clearly defined success measures covering business outcomes, customer experience, operational performance, adoption and financial value.
* Maintain traceability between contracted deliverables, implementation outcomes and the customer’s business case.
* Work with Customer Success and account teams to monitor adoption, benefits realization and achievement of agreed outcomes following deployment.
* Facilitate periodic executive value reviews to demonstrate progress, validate realized benefits and agree corrective or expansion actions.
* Ensure delivery decisions prioritize time-to-value and sustainable customer outcomes—not simply technical completion.
* Identify opportunities to expand adoption and deepen the customer’s strategic use of Genesys capabilities where this supports genuine customer value.

**Revenue and Financial Accountability**

* Own the consolidated financial performance of assigned strategic programs and provide governance over the regional project portfolio.
* Ensure accurate forecasting of revenue, backlog conversion, delivery velocity, resource demand and project completion.
* Monitor revenue realization, project margin, effort consumption, change requests, milestone achievement and financial risks.
* Work with delivery and resource leaders to align staffing with project priorities, skills requirements, utilization and profitability objectives.
* Identify and resolve conditions that could delay revenue recognition or negatively affect margin.
* Ensure changes in scope are governed effectively and translated into appropriate commercial change controls.
* Partner with Sales and account leadership to identify follow-on services opportunities while maintaining clear separation between delivery commitments and new scope.
* Contribute directly to achievement of regional Genesys revenue and professional-services performance targets.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Create alignment among Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, Support, Finance, partners and customer teams.
* Establish an effective cadence for program leadership, workstream coordination, account-team alignment and executive steering.
* Ensure decisions, actions and dependencies are documented, communicated and tracked to completion.
* Build a culture of ownership, transparency, constructive challenge and continuous improvement.
* Represent regional delivery in strategic account planning, executive reviews and pre-sales discussions for complex opportunities.
* Provide delivery insight during opportunity qualification, solution planning and commercial development to ensure commitments are achievable.
* Capture and share lessons learned, reusable assets and delivery best practices across the region.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* Typically 15 or more years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, 12 or more years with a master’s degree, or 8 or more years with a PhD; equivalent combinations of education and substantial professional experience will also be considered.
* Recognized expertise in enterprise program management, professional-services delivery, customer transformation or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated success leading large, complex and strategically important programs involving multiple projects, functions, partners and geographies.
* Proven ability to serve as a principal adviser to senior leaders, helping shape critical decisions and resolve issues that materially affect customer outcomes, program success and organizational objectives.
* Extensive experience establishing governance structures, delivery standards, operating plans and controls for complex enterprise programs.
* Strong track record of solving ambiguous and high-impact problems where information may be incomplete, considerable judgment is required and decisions have long-term implications.
* Demonstrated ability to assess risks and develop solutions that account for dependencies and impacts across multiple functions, business units or geographies.
* Proven accountability for program financial performance, including revenue forecasting, backlog conversion, delivery velocity, margin management, resource planning and commercial change control.
* Demonstrated experience connecting technology delivery to measurable customer business outcomes, adoption goals and value-realization objectives.
* Strong executive presence, with experience establishing trusted relationships and formal networks with senior internal leaders, customer executives, partners and other external decision-makers.
* Ability to serve as a Genesys expert and external spokesperson on strategic program delivery, governance and transformation matters.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive action across organizational boundaries without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Experience providing guidance, coaching and professional development to Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Managers and other delivery professionals.
* Proven ability to lead large cross-functional initiatives of strategic importance. Direct people-management experience is beneficial but is not a prerequisite for the role.
* Deep understanding of enterprise cloud transformation, customer-experience technology and professional-services delivery. Experience with Genesys Cloud or large-scale contact-center transformation is strongly preferred.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, conflict-resolution and escalation-management capabilities.
* Project or program management certification—such as PgMP, PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent—is preferred.

**Leadership Capabilities**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Executive presence and credibility.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Customer- and outcome-first decision-making.
* Commercial and financial acumen.
* Structured problem-solving and sound judgment.
* The ability to see both program-level detail and the broader strategic picture.
* Confidence operating in ambiguity and managing competing priorities.
* Empathy combined with the willingness to address difficult issues directly.
* The ability to influence without relying on formal authority.
* A continuous-improvement mindset and commitment to delivery excellence.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Title: Senior Customer Success Manager

Title: Manager – Strategic Partnerships & Commercial Delivery
Industry: Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals
Description:
**Position Summary:**

We are seeking a commercially driven professional to develop strategic partnerships, grow key accounts, and lead the successful execution of new business initiatives across the iPay Group. The role combines business development and sales, strategic account management, and hands-on project delivery, with a focus on Fintech, Telecommunications, eCommerce, and Technology Solutions. The successful candidate will identify new business opportunities, develop commercially viable propositions, secure customers and partnerships, and drive complex initiatives from concept through implementation and revenue generation.The position requires someone who can think strategically, engage senior stakeholders, manage cross-functional teams, and take ownership of commercial results. It is a hands-on role that goes beyond traditional sales or account management.

**Salary Up to AED 25,000**
.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Business Development & Sales**

Proactively identify, prospect, and acquire new corporate customers and strategic partners across target industries.

* Develop business development strategies, sales pipelines, and account acquisition plans aligned with the Group's growth priorities.
* Lead the full sales cycle, from opportunity identification and customer engagement to solution development, negotiation, and closing.
* Evaluate new opportunities, develop business cases, and assess commercial feasibility, revenue potential, costs, and profitability.
* Develop commercial proposals, partnership structures, and go-to-market strategies for new products and services.

**2. Key Account Management & Revenue Growth**

* Own and develop relationships with key corporate customers, strategic partners, and senior decision-makers.
* Build structured account plans identifying growth opportunities, stakeholders, revenue targets, and engagement priorities.
* Identify and execute cross-selling and upselling opportunities across iPay Group's businesses.
* Monitor account performance and implement action plans to improve revenue, customer adoption, and profitability.
* Drive the commercialization of existing partnerships and newly launched services, ensuring they generate the expected business results.
* Conduct regular strategic account reviews and maintain strong relationships across multiple levels of customer organizations.

**3. Project Delivery**

* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, resources, and key dependencies.
* Lead and coordinate multiple stakeholders across Technology, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, internal business units, external partners, and customers.
* Establish project governance, monitor progress, manage risks, and proactively resolve implementation challenges.
* Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, technical capabilities, and operational execution.
* Drive projects to successful completion, ensuring timely delivery, stakeholder alignment, and achievement of commercial objectives.

**4. Strategic Initiatives & New Ventures**

* Identify opportunities to leverage capabilities, customer relationships, and synergies across iPay Group companies.
* Support the development and commercialization of new products, partnerships, and revenue streams.
* Coordinate pilots and proofs of concept, evaluate their performance, and develop recommendations for expansion.
* Collaborate with subsidiary management teams and external partners to translate strategic initiatives into executable business plans.

**5. Commercial Performance & Reporting**

* Achieve agreed sales, revenue growth, profitability, and strategic account development targets.
* Monitor commercial performance against forecasts, business cases, and contractual commitments.
* Maintain an active sales pipeline and prepare regular revenue forecasts and management reports.
* Provide senior management with structured updates on commercial opportunities, project progress, risks, and required decisions.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Technology, or a related discipline. MBA is an advantage.

* Proven hands-on experience managing complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience developing business cases, commercial proposals, financial forecasts, and partnership agreements.
* Experience in Fintech, Telecommunications, eCommerce, Digital Services, SaaS, or Enterprise Technology Solutions.
* Proficiency in CRM, Excel, PowerPoint, and project-management tools.
* Excellent English communication and presentation skills; Arabic is an advantage.
* Experience with product launches, or cross-company initiatives is an advantage.

Title: Information Technology Project Manager
Industry: Software Development, IT System Training and Support, and IT System Design Services
Description:
The IT Project Manager delivers IT projects across the group and oversees business applications, cloud platforms, infrastructure coordination, vendors and IT governance. The role bridges business stakeholders, IT teams and technology partners, ensuring solutions meet business needs, are delivered on time and within approved scope and budget, and are transitioned smoothly into operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Project Management & Delivery**

* Lead IT projects end-to-end: initiation, requirements, planning, execution, testing, go-live, handover and closure.
* Build and maintain project plans, milestones, budgets, resource plans, RAID logs and dependency maps.
* Coordinate business stakeholders, internal IT teams, vendors and consultants to deliver agreed scope on time and within budget.
* Run project governance: steering committee and status reporting, action tracking, change control and escalation.
* Manage UAT, cutover, deployment and stabilization, and hand over cleanly to business and IT operations.
* Complete lessons learned, closure reports and knowledge transfer for every project.
* Provide or coordinate L1/L2 application support during the post-go-live stabilization period.

**2. Business Applications Management**

* Own the day-to-day management of core applications, including Microsoft Dynamics 365, Ramco HCM, Focus, Sage and other enterprise systems.
* Coordinate with application vendors and implementation partners on support, incident resolution, enhancements, integrations, upgrades and patches.
* Work with business departments to understand processes and pain points, and translate requirements into functional and technical solutions.
* Maintain application roadmaps, enhancement backlogs and release plans, including testing and deployment.
* Keep application documentation, support procedures, access controls and vendor contacts current.
* Coordinate integrations across Microsoft 365, Azure, GCP and ERP, HR, property, finance and other systems.

**3. Microsoft 365 & Licensing**

* Manage Microsoft 365 subscriptions, license allocation, renewals, utilization and cost optimization.
* Work with Microsoft partners on licensing, technical issues and service changes.
* Oversee identity, access, administrative roles, security controls and compliance for Microsoft 365, together with the infrastructure and security teams.

**4. Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Coordinate the group's Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform environments with providers, vendors and internal technical teams.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, integration and disaster recovery initiatives.
* Track cloud usage and cost, and act on optimization opportunities.
* Ensure cloud environments follow approved architecture, security, access, backup and governance standards.

**5. Network, Server & Cybersecurity Coordination**

* Coordinate support of networks, servers, firewalls, VPN, backup and endpoint services with the IT technical team.
* Coordinate cybersecurity tooling, including Trend Micro XDR and other security technologies.
* Drive vulnerability remediation, security updates, monitoring, access control, backup and DR improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure and security issues affecting business applications are escalated, tracked and resolved.

**6. Business Relationship & Solution Management**

* Act as the primary IT contact for business stakeholders across the group.
* Run workshops and requirement-gathering sessions with users and process owners.
* Prepare business cases, solution comparisons and vendor evaluations for management approval.
* Coordinate demonstrations, proofs of concept and technical assessments.

**7. IT Governance, Policies & Controls**

* Establish and maintain IT project governance standards, templates, reporting and controls.
* Develop, review and implement IT policies, procedures and operating guidelines.
* Ensure projects and IT services comply with policies, security requirements and internal controls.
* Maintain documentation for management, audit and compliance; support IT audits and close findings.
* Ensure approval, change, access and vendor management processes are followed.

**8. Vendor & Contract Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, system integrators, software providers, cloud providers and managed service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, deliverables and milestones; lead service reviews and improvement plans.
* Support procurement: RFP/RFQ preparation, technical and commercial evaluation, negotiation, renewals and contract review.
* Identify opportunities to reduce vendor dependency and optimize IT spend.

**9. IT Service Management & Operational Support**

* Coordinate incidents, service requests, problems and escalations that need project or application management involvement.
* Ensure projects transition into operations with documentation, SLAs, support models and knowledge transfer.
* Analyze recurring incidents and drive permanent fixes, automation and process improvement.
* Coordinate business continuity, disaster recovery, backup and service restoration for critical IT services.

**10. Team & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate application, infrastructure, network, system administration and service desk (L1/L2) resources as required.
* Prioritize work by business criticality, project commitments, risk and available capacity.
* Provide direction and escalation support to technical teams and external providers.
* Promote collaboration between IT, business departments, vendors and senior management.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* Proven end-to-end delivery of enterprise IT projects.
* Mandatory: hands-on or strong functional/project experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Experience managing enterprise business applications, including support, enhancements, integrations and rollouts.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration/licensing and Azure and/or GCP.
* Sound understanding of network, server, firewall, backup, endpoint and cybersecurity environments.
* Experience managing IT vendors, implementation partners, SLAs, contracts and technology evaluations.
* Experience in IT governance, policies, change management, risk management and project reporting.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, problem-solving and analytical skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.
* ITIL certification.

**Technology Scope :**

**Business Applications**

Microsoft Dynamics 365, Ramco HCM, Focus, Sage and other enterprise applications

**Cloud Platforms**

Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

**Productivity & Collaboration**

Microsoft 365

**Infrastructure**

Network, servers, firewalls, backup, connectivity, endpoint services

**Cybersecurity**

The **Platform Lead** is a senior technology leader responsible for the architecture, evolution, reliability, and operational performance of Torstar’s shared digital platform capabilities. This role partners closely with the Mobile lead to translate the organization’s technology strategy into scalable, secure, and well-governed platform services that enable mobile and web product teams to deliver effectively.

The Platform Lead provides deep expertise across backend systems, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, integrations, data and analytics infrastructure, content-management capabilities, identity, subscriptions, payments, email platforms, and operational engineering practices. The role leads the platform engineering team and acts as a trusted technical partner to the Mobile lead, with responsibility for platform execution and domain-level technical decisions.

While this role has significant technical and people leadership responsibility, the Chief Product Officer retains overall accountability for organization-wide technology strategy, senior leadership engagement, and the full digital technology portfolio.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and ongoing evolution of Torstar’s shared digital platform services and infrastructure.
* Own the reliability, scalability, security, maintainability, and performance of platform capabilities that support mobile, web, data, editorial, subscription, advertising, and other digital products.
* Lead and develop platform engineering, DevOps, QA, and related technical team members as assigned.
* Partner with the Chief Product Officer on enterprise technology strategy, architecture, investment priorities, and delivery planning.
* Establish and maintain platform engineering standards for APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, security, resilience, and incident management.
* Ensure that platform roadmaps enable product teams—particularly the mobile team—to deliver customer value quickly, reliably, and safely.
* Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions, architectural guidance, and implementation plans.
* Lead the technical assessment, selection, integration, and management of platform technologies, vendors, and external delivery partners.
* Improve engineering productivity through strong developer tooling, automation, documentation, deployment practices, and operational processes.
* Monitor platform health and production-quality metrics; identify risks, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
* Support technology governance by documenting architectural decisions, managing technical debt, and maintaining a clear view of platform dependencies and risks.
* Collaborate with Product, Data, Editorial, Revenue, Security, and other stakeholders to ensure technology solutions meet organizational needs.
* Keep current with developments in cloud platforms, AI, data infrastructure, backend systems, security, and software delivery practices.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering at this level of technical scope and complexity.
* 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading technical teams or major platform initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and shared technology services.
* Strong knowledge of modern cloud computing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, security, system reliability, and software architecture.
* Experience supporting large-scale, consumer-facing digital products or high-availability digital platforms.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor engineers while driving complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Experience with platform domains such as content management, identity and access management, subscriptions, payments, data and analytics, email platforms, or enterprise integrations is strongly preferred.
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Title: Vice President - Technology Commercials and Delivery
Description:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.

Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure & entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing & logistics, and science.

**For the Good of Tomorrow**

Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
**Vice President – Technology Commercials & Delivery**
at Dubai Holding. The role holder is responsible for the commercial performance and delivery reliability of Dubai Holding Group IT. The role owns the Group IT sourcing strategy, vendor and contract commercials, and the Group IT delivery model, ensuring that every service, programme and supplier relationship delivers measurable value for its cost.

The role puts Group IT's “How We Operate” principles into practice: explicit ownership, deliberate sourcing choices, realistic delivery commitments through Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), and supplier management that connects service performance with commercial value. It manages the end-to-end commercial lifecycle – from sourcing strategy and negotiation through contract performance, renewal and exit – and the delivery governance that turns approved demand into on-time, on-budget outcomes.

The role acts as the Group CTO's lead for commercials and delivery, partnering with Group Procurement, Group Finance, Legal, Strategy & Value Creation and the Verticals to reduce cost-to-serve, remove duplication across contracts, and ensure Group IT commits only to what it can deliver.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**Commercial Strategy & Sourcing**

* Define and own the Group IT commercial and sourcing strategy, aligned to Group CTO priorities and Dubai Holding procurement policy
* Make deliberate retain, partner, automate or buy decisions for each service area, based on operational criticality, control requirements, cost, flexibility and knowledge retention
* Consolidate demand across Central IT and the Verticals to use Group-wide buying power and remove duplicate contracts
* Lead category strategies for software, cloud, infrastructure, telecoms, professional services and managed services

**Vendor Negotiation & Contract Management**

* Lead commercial negotiations for strategic technology agreements, including enterprise licensing, cloud commitments, multi-year and outcome-based contracts
* Own the contract portfolio lifecycle: renewals calendar, true-ups, price reviews, benchmarking and exit planning
* Ensure contracts include clear SLAs, KPIs, service credits, termination rights, IP and data protection terms, in partnership with Legal and Procurement
* Review contract terms, consumption and duplication to identify renegotiation, consolidation and termination opportunities

**Supplier Performance & Value Realisation**

* Establish a tiered supplier management framework with regular business reviews for strategic suppliers
* Connect supplier service performance with commercial value, tracking SLA compliance, service credits, penalties and delivered outcomes
* Track savings and cost avoidance, validated with IT Finance
* Manage supplier risk, including concentration, financial stability and third-party cyber risk, with Information Security and IT GRC

**Delivery Model & Portfolio Execution**

* Own the Group IT delivery model, ensuring programmes and projects are delivered on time, on budget and to agreed scope
* Run delivery planning through SPM, using effort estimates and capacity checks so that commitments are realistic
* Set common delivery discipline for ownership, progress, risk and commitments, while allowing teams to use suitable execution methods (agile, waterfall or hybrid)
* Drive transparent reprioritisation when capacity or demand changes materially, escalating trade-offs to the Group CTO

**Partner & System Integrator Delivery Oversight**

* Oversee delivery by system integrators and managed service partners, with clear internal accountability and effective interfaces
* Define statements of work, acceptance criteria, milestone payments and change control that protect Dubai Holding's commercial position
* Intervene early on underperforming engagements and apply commercial levers where needed
* Ensure knowledge transfer and avoid unhealthy dependency on any single partner

**Commercial & Financial Governance**

* Ensure all sourcing and contracting complies with Dubai Holding procurement policy, Delegation of Authority (DOA) and audit requirements
* Partner with IT Finance on budgets, commitments, accruals and the commercial basis for chargeback to the Verticals
* Maintain a complete, auditable record of contracts, approvals and commercial decisions, and support Internal Audit and external audit reviews
* Build business cases with clear total cost of ownership (TCO), ROI and payback for major sourcing decisions

**Deliver Agentic AI Capabilities**

* Manage delivery of strategic group-level AI agentic projects and initiatives
* Support and deliver vertical-level implementations of strategic AI platforms
* Deliver business transformation projects to meet group-level value creation and efficiency objectives

**AI-Enabled Commercial & Delivery Operations**

* Evaluate and negotiate agentic AI and automation platforms, including consumption- and credit-based pricing models
* Apply AI and analytics to contract intelligence, spend analytics, renewal risk and delivery forecasting
* Apply “Right Work, Right Owner” in sourcing decisions, moving repetitive work to automation where it creates value
* Ensure AI vendor contracts address data ownership, model use, IP, responsible use and exit terms

**Leadership, Stakeholder Management & Reporting**

* Build and lead a high-performing commercial, vendor management and delivery team
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Group CTO and Group IT leadership on commercial and delivery matters
* Provide executive reporting on the contract portfolio, supplier performance, savings and delivery status for leadership forums, steering committees and quarterly business reviews
* Build strong working relationships with Procurement, Finance, Legal and Vertical leadership

**What we’re looking for:**

* 15+ years in technology commercial management, sourcing, vendor management and/or IT delivery in large, complex organisations
* 8+ years in senior leadership roles leading commercial and delivery teams
* Proven record of negotiating high-value technology contracts and delivering measurable, validated savings
* Experience leading portfolio and programme delivery at scale, including oversight of system integrators and managed service partners
* Experience in complex, multi-entity organisations (real estate, hospitality, investment or similar sectors preferred); GCC/UAE experience preferred

**Education/Professional Certification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Finance or a related field
* MBA or relevant Master's degree strongly preferred
* CIPS or IAOP (COP) certification preferred
* PMP / MSP / PRINCE2, ITIL v4 or SAFe certifications
* FinOps Certified Practitioner is an advantage

**Technical Competencies:**

* Strong analytical thinking and commercial judgement
* Deep knowledge of technology commercial models: enterprise licensing, SaaS, cloud consumption, outcome-based and managed services
* Contract fundamentals, negotiation strategy and commercial risk management
* Vendor and third-party risk management frameworks
* Portfolio and programme management, including SPM tools (e.g., ServiceNow SPM or equivalent)
* Financial acumen: TCO, ROI, CapEx/OpEx, budgeting and forecasting
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion procurement and contract processes
* Data-driven reporting and dashboards (e.g., Power BI)
* Understanding of AI and agentic platform pricing and commercial structures

**Behavioural Competencies:**

* Strong executive presence and influence at C-suite level
* Tough, fair negotiator who protects Dubai Holding's interests while building long-term partnerships
* Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline
* Clear, direct communicator who makes trade-offs and commitments explicit
* Results-oriented with high personal accountability and integrity
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams

Description:

**Our Purpose**

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

The AI & Technical Security Standards Manager leads the development, maintenance, and implementation of global cybersecurity standards covering artificial intelligence and other technically complex security domains. The role converts strategic, regulatory, risk, and engineering requirements into clear, practical, and measurable standards that can be adopted consistently across Deloitte Global.

This is a technically focused management role requiring sufficient depth to evaluate emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and hold credible discussions with security architects, engineers, data scientists, AI specialists, risk professionals, and other subject matter experts. The successful candidate will balance technical rigor with clear policy writing, and sound judgement.

The role works across Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to establish authoritative requirements, resolve complex standards questions, and support adoption. It also monitors developments in AI, cloud, software, infrastructure, and security engineering to ensure the standards portfolio remains relevant and forward-looking.

**Key Responsibilities**

***AI and technical security standards leadership***

* Own and manage the lifecycle (drafting, review, approval, publishing, maintenance) of Deloitte’s Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for AI and assigned technical security domains.
* Develop outcome-focused requirements that are technically credible, risk-based, and suitable for implementation across varied technology environments.
* Define security expectations for the design, development, acquisition, deployment, operation, and retirement of AI-enabled systems and supporting technology.
* Maintain new and revised standards, prioritized according to enterprise risk, regulatory change, technology adoption, and stakeholder need.
* Ensure AI-specific Deloitte Global Cybersecurity policies and standards are supported by clear guidance, control objectives, implementation considerations, and evidence expectations.

***Technical analysis and subject matter engagement***

* Lead detailed discussions with subject matter experts to understand technologies, threat scenarios, design constraints, and appropriate safeguards.
* Analyze architecture, engineering practices, threat intelligence, incidents, and control performance to identify where standards require clarification or enhancement.
* Translate complex technical concepts into concise requirements for technical and non-technical audiences without losing accuracy or intent.

**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------

***AI security and emerging technology***

* Enhance Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for generative AI, machine learning, autonomous and agentic systems, AI platforms, models, data, integrations, and third-party AI services.
* Assess threats including prompt injection, insecure model and tool integration, sensitive data exposure, model manipulation, supply-chain compromise, excessive agency, and inadequate human oversight.
* Apply relevant industry and regulatory frameworks, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and OWASP guidance, while adapting requirements to the organization’s risk context.

***Standards governance and assurance***

* Manage consultation, review, approval, publication, exception, and periodic review processes in accordance with the Global Cybersecurity Policy and Standards governance framework.
* Define measures for standards adoption and effectiveness, and provide clear reporting on implementation progress, material gaps, exceptions, and emerging risks.
* Support assurance and control teams in interpreting standards, evaluating evidence, and distinguishing material risk from implementation variance.

***Team leadership and talent development***

* Provide inclusive, visible, and accountable leadership to analysts on the team, setting clear direction and translating strategic priorities into achievable objectives.
* Build team capability through regular coaching, mentoring, constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and meaningful development opportunities, while fostering collaboration, technical curiosity, and high professional standards.
* Align internal resources, external vendors, and specialist expertise to business priorities; establish clear roles, governance, decision rights, service expectations, and SLAs; monitor capacity, program performance, delivery quality, risks, and dependencies.
* Recognize strong contributions; and promote ownership, resilience, and continuous improvement so that the team consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.

***Risk, regulatory, and industry alignment***

* Monitor changes in laws, regulations, contractual obligations, threat patterns, and recognized frameworks that affect AI and technical security requirements.
* Map standards to internal controls and external frameworks to support traceability, assurance, and regulatory response.
* Provide risk-based advice on deviations and exceptions, ensuring decisions, compensating controls, ownership, and remediation commitments are appropriately documented.

***Stakeholder leadership and enablement***

* Build productive relationships with stakeholders (Deloitte Firm SMEs), security and technology leaders, architects, engineers, product teams and risk owners.
* Chair working groups and facilitate constructive technical challenges to achieve clear, proportionate, and implementable requirements.
* Produce briefings and decision materials that help teams understand both the requirement and the risk it addresses.

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. Title: Technology Application Services Manager
Description:
**Purpose of the role:**

The Technology Application Services Manager is accountable for the architectural integrity, operational support, service continuity, and long-term health of the Bank's business applications. The role owns portfolio rationalization, internal application support, vendor-provided support, vendor management, and leadership of the Application Services team.

**B. ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Application Ownership & Solution Architecture**

* Own solution design and architecture across the Bank's business applications estate.
* Hold design authority and provide sign-off on proposed solutions, upgrades, and customizations.
* Define and enforce integration and API standards across the portfolio, maintaining architectural coherence between systems.
* Partner with the Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Lead and Delivery Leads on cross-domain initiatives.

**Portfolio Health & Rationalization**

* Maintain an ongoing view of the applications portfolio's health, identifying underperforming systems, technical debt, and enhancement, upgrade, or replacement requirements.
* Translate findings into recommendations that feed budget and roadmap planning.

**Deployment, Release & Quality Management**

* Establish and maintain a DevOps methodology and toolset spanning version control and build management.
* Hold vendors accountable for build and release quality.
* Ensure application health monitoring and operational support controls are in place, with accountability for uptime, incident rates, support performance, and service improvement across the estate.

**Application Support & Vendor Management**

* Own the end-to-end application support model across the estate, covering support delivered internally by the Application Services team and support provided by vendors or other third parties.
* Ensure incidents, service requests, recurring problems, and user issues are triaged, investigated, resolved, escalated, and communicated in line with agreed service levels.
* Act as the senior escalation point for application support issues, coordinating internal technical resources and vendors through to resolution and ensuring root-cause analysis and corrective actions are completed.
* Manage vendor-provided support, including support agreements, SLAs, service performance, escalations, and value for money.

**Budget & Portfolio Planning**

* Own the annual applications budget, linking funding requirements to portfolio rationalization findings.

**Delivery Support**

* Provide technical input and estimates during planning.
* Ensure environments, builds and integration points are ready ahead of milestones.
* Ensure quality gates are met before release.

**People Leadership**

* Manage, develop and lead the Application Services team.
* Own hiring input, performance management and development planning.
* Establish cross-training to reduce key-man dependency.
* Foster technical excellence and ownership.

**C. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPI)**

*To measure and monitor the performance of the role in the context of the Section/Department's activities*

* System uptime & incident rates (estate-wide)
* Architecture standards adherence
* Portfolio health & rationalization
* Internal and vendor-provided application support performance
* Vendor performance, SLA compliance & cost
* Portfolio & budget management
* Team capability & engagement

**D. EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

**Minimum Experience & Essential Knowledge**

* 15 years progressive experience in Information Technology, with at least 5 years in a people leadership / team lead capacity
* Financial services background in a similar environment (investment management, core banking, or private wealth) in a lead capacity is a mandatory requirement
* Experience within a bank, investment firm, or other regulated financial services environment
* Expertise across core banking, CRM/ERP, integration/middleware, and investment management platforms desirable (e.g. T24/Temenos, Microsoft Dynamics)
* Proven experience in solution architecture and integration/API design across enterprise applications
* Experience establishing and maturing DevOps practices, including deployment governance and release management
* Experience leading internal application support operations and managing vendor-provided support, including incident, problem, request, escalation, and SLA management

**Minimum Entry Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline

**Certifications desirable:**

* Temenos T24 certification
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification
* TOGAF
* ITIL Foundation
* Azure/cloud DevOps certification

Title: Customer Success Manager - UAE
Description:

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
  
  
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
  
  
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
  
  
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
  
  
**Why This Role?**
We’re seeking an exceptional Customer Success Manager with deep expertise in the UAE private sector enterprise landscape to lead our most strategic accounts across these dynamic markets. This role requires an individual who understands both the transformative potential of frontier AI and the unique requirements of private sector organizations in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Strategic Customer Partnership**

* Own the success, adoption, and growth of Cohere’s UAE private sector customers, ensuring they realize maximum value from our AI solutions.
* Build deep, trusted relationships with senior enterprise stakeholders, including CXOs, VPs, Directors, and digital transformation leads.
* Develop comprehensive success plans tailored to each organization’s mission, digital strategy, budget cycles, and unique constraints.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and executive sponsor for your accounts, managing escalations and ensuring customer satisfaction.
* Define and track success metrics aligned with private sector priorities: ROI, revenue growth, operational efficiency, cost savings, and innovation outcomes.

**AI Adoption & Implementation Leadership**

* Guide customers through the full lifecycle of AI adoption—from use case identification and pilot design through production deployment and scaling.
* Lead secure AI implementation projects in complex enterprise environments, including sensitive systems and on-premises deployments.
* Navigate the unique challenges of UAE private sector AI adoption: legacy system integration, data sensitivity, regulatory compliance (UAE Labour Law, Saudi business regulations), and cultural considerations.
* Create and execute change management strategies to drive user adoption and value realization across diverse enterprise workforces.
* Conduct regular executive business reviews with senior stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, impact, and strategic value.
* Drive contract renewals and account growth by consistently delivering value and building trusted relationships.

**Customer Advocacy & Product Influence**

* Serve as the voice of UAE private sector customers within Cohere, advocating for features and capabilities that address regional enterprise needs.
* Provide strategic feedback to Product and Engineering teams on requirements related to security, explainability, Arabic language support, and ethical AI.
* Contribute to the development of UAE-specific enterprise offerings, implementation playbooks, documentation, and best practices.
* Share customer insights to inform Cohere’s regional go-to-market strategy and positioning.
* Represent Cohere at regional business forums, industry events, and enterprise roundtables.

**Required Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic consulting, or technology delivery roles within enterprise or private sector contexts.
* At least 3-5 years working directly with UAE enterprises across industries such as finance, healthcare, logistics, or technology.
* Proven track record of managing complex, strategic accounts with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and multi-year implementation timelines.
* Experience leading AI/ML, cloud, or enterprise software implementations in secure or highly regulated environments.
* Experience developing and executing customer success strategies, QBRs, and executive engagement programs.

* Fluent Arabic and English language proficiency—essential for working across regional markets.

* Knowledge of relevant regulations: UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree Law No. 33 of 2021), Saudi business regulations, and data protection frameworks.
* Familiarity with national initiatives: Saudi Vision 2030, UAE Digital Transformation Strategy, and Smart Dubai.

* Experience with UAE enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
* Direct experience with regional defense, financial services, or healthcare sectors.
* Background in management consulting, systems integration, or digital transformation consulting for regional clients.

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
  
  
Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

Title: Director of Information Security (Saudi Only)
Description:

Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Management platform that helps organizations understand, engage, and serve their customers at scale. Our platform brings together customer intelligence, omnichannel engagement, and agentic AI so teams can turn customer insight into meaningful action.
  
  
As we grow across enterprise and government markets in the region, protecting customer data and earning trust are central to how we build products and run our business.
  
  
**The Role**
We are hiring a
**Director of Information Security**
to lead and scale Lucidya's security function across our products, cloud infrastructure, corporate environment, and compliance programs.
  
  
Reporting directly to the
**Chief Technology Officer**
, you will own the security roadmap, build and lead the security team, and partner with Engineering, Product, SRE, DevOps, IT, Legal, People, Sales, and Customer Experience.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. One day you might be reviewing an architecture design or leading an incident response; the next, walking an auditor through our controls or explaining our security posture to a government customer. Your job is to turn security requirements into practical controls, clear ownership, and measurable progress.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
*Security Leadership and Governance*

* Define and execute Lucidya's security strategy and roadmap, aligned with business priorities and customer commitments
* Lead, mentor, and grow the security team with clear responsibilities and development plans
* Drive agentic transformation across the team's operations, applying AI agents to work such as alert triage, evidence collection, vulnerability management, and security questionnaires
* Own security policies, standards, risk assessments, and the risk register, including processes for exceptions, risk acceptance, and escalation
* Manage security tooling, service providers, and budget, and report posture, risks, and incidents to executive leadership

*Compliance and Audit Readiness*

* Lead the implementation and maintenance of controls for Saudi PDPL, NCA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other relevant frameworks
* Maintain the Information Security Management System and coordinate control ownership across departments
* Keep audit evidence accurate and ready, manage audit preparation and findings, and verify that documented controls actually operate effectively
* Partner with Legal on data protection, retention, access, and contractual security requirements

*Product, Application, and Cloud Security*

* Embed security into architecture, development, testing, and deployment, including automated scanning of code, dependencies, secrets, containers, and infrastructure
* Define release security criteria, remediation timelines, and exception processes
* Lead threat modeling and security reviews for major product changes, integrations, and AI capabilities
* Oversee penetration testing, adversarial testing, and vulnerability assessments through to verified resolution
* Review security across AWS and GCP (identity, privileged access, networking, encryption, secrets, logging) and maintain visibility over internet-facing assets

*Corporate Security and Awareness*

* Set security requirements for employee devices, identities, and internal applications, and work with IT to implement and verify them
* Oversee access reviews across onboarding, role changes, and offboarding
* Run security awareness training, phishing exercises, and targeted education for technical and business teams
* Assess the security risk of third-party tools and vendors handling company or customer data
* Define and verify network and physical security standards for our office site

*Security Operations and Incident Response*

* Own the security operations model, including internal responsibilities, external SOC/MDR providers, monitoring coverage, and after-hours escalation
* Oversee log collection, detection, alert triage, and investigation across cloud, application, identity, endpoint, and network
* Maintain incident response plans and playbooks, lead incident coordination and post-incident reviews, and run regular simulations
* Work with Legal, leadership, and customer teams on timely, accurate notifications when incidents affect customers

*Customer Trust and Vulnerability Disclosure*

* Manage Lucidya's vulnerability disclosure program from researcher contact through closure

Title: Regional Manager, Fleet Strategy, Planning and Programs, MEATR, MEATR DSP
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver orders. Our goal is to exceed the expectations of all our customers. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile delivery space.  
  
The MEATR (Middle East, Africa, and Turkey) Fleet organization is responsible for managing and growing Amazon's Last Mile Fleet across the region. We are seeking an exceptional Senior Manager to lead Fleet Strategy, Planning and Programs for the MEATR (Africa, Middle East, and Turkey) region—one of our fastest-growing and most dynamic markets.  
  
In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic architect of MEATRs fleet operations, responsible for the complete fleet lifecycle from demand forecasting and procurement to operational excellence and partner experience. You'll leverage sophisticated analytical modeling to predict fleet requirements years in advance, drive operational excellence through data-driven insights, and ensure our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) have the tools and support they need to succeed.  
This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of Amazon's logistics capabilities in a high-growth region. You'll work at the intersection of strategy, operations, analytics, and partnership management—driving decisions that impact hundreds of millions of dollars in capital investments while building the foundation for sustainable growth.  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep analytical capabilities with strong business acumen and exceptional stakeholder management skills. You'll need to be equally comfortable building sophisticated forecasting models, coaching operations teams on best practices, and presenting strategic recommendations to senior leadership. You'll thrive in ambiguity, design scalable solutions for emerging markets, and have a commitment to operational excellence and customer obsession.  
This role requires approximately 30% travel across the MEATR region to build relationships, conduct operational assessments, and drive change management initiatives.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Fleet Demand Planning & Forecasting  
  
Design and develop scalable fleet demand modeling to predict last mile van / size requirements across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey  
Create demand plans for multiple vehicle specifications (diesel/electric, long/short wheel base, specialized configurations) across long-term strategic (+3 years), medium-term tactical (12-18 months), and short-term operational (Consolidate input from diverse stakeholders to ensure fleet plans always consume the latest available assumptions and business strategies  
  
2. Strategic Partnerships & Vendor Management  
Develop and execute strategic partnerships across the MEATR transportation ecosystem, focusing on long-term value creation with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), rental/leasing providers, upfitting vendors, maintenance service providers, and parts suppliers (in partnership with Global Fleet Procurement GFP organization)  
Identify and capitalize on commercial opportunities through market analysis, competitive benchmarking, cost optimization initiatives, multi-country fleet sharing, and alternative supply channels (e.g., used vehicle markets)  
  
3. Network Capacity & Supply Chain Optimization  
Lead strategic initiatives to optimize network capacity across MEATR, balancing fleet supply and demand across stations, coordinating short-term deployment scheduling, and optimizing for seasonal demand variations  
Collaborate extensively with Finance business partners to ensure plans are efficient and meet peak demand requirements, drive efficient capital allocation (CAPEX), optimize operating expenses (OPEX), and develop Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models  
Develop innovative program management mechanisms to drive data-driven decision-making across make vs. buy vs. rent trade-offs, vehicle type mix optimization, asset utilization improvements, and investment prioritization  
Monitor and optimize key metrics to ensure smooth supply chain operations, addressing procurement lead times, parts availability, and cross-border logistics complexities unique to MEATR markets  
  
4. DSP Partner Experience & Voice of Customer  
Establish and expand listening mechanisms to capture Delivery Service Partner feedback including regular surveys, sentiment analysis, focus groups, partner councils, operational data analysis, and direct engagement during station visits  
Analyze, report, and take action on customer feedback data to identify and drive opportunities to improve the level of service GFP offers to DSP partners, combining qualitative sentiment data with quantitative service benchmarking  
Identify and prioritize DSP pain points related to fleet operations including vehicle reliability, maintenance processes, administrative burden, cost transparency, and training gaps  
Develop and launch innovative programs and value-added services to improve DSP experience and productivity (e.g., preventive maintenance programs, roadside assistance, simplified processes, self-service tools, training materials)  
Measure DSP satisfaction through Net Promoter Score (NPS), program adoption rates, and qualitative feedback themes, with target improvements of +5 NPS points annually  
Collaborate with DSP Program teams across organizations to ensure fleet decisions consider partner impact, co-develop solutions to shared challenges, and maintain strong exchange of insights on partner needs  
  
5. Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence  
Own executive-level business reviews and strategic planning sessions, delivering data-driven insights and actionable recommendations to VP and senior leadership stakeholders  
Write and contribute to compelling business cases using information synthesized from multiple stakeholders, propose and obtain approval from functional leaders, and maintain project schedules that enable teams to succeed  
Take accountability while providing transparent status updates, proactively asking for help and immediately escalating issues and problems as necessary to remove blockers  
  
6. Innovation & Strategic Initiatives  
Drive the transition to electrification by integrating Electric Vehicle (EV) planning into business-as-usual fleet requirement processes, considering charging infrastructure, range requirements, and total cost of ownership  
Extend Fleet Requirement Planning processes to new business customer organizations (e.g., Sub-same Day, DSP Lite) and new countries as MEATR expands, building replicable playbooks for rapid market entry  
Lead full life-cycle of complex cross-functional projects and programs with considerable impact across multiple organizations, working to understand business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, and reasons behind leadership decisions  
Design solutions that can adapt to each MEATR market's unique maturity level, account for varying data availability and quality, work within local constraints, and maintain global standards while allowing regional flexibility  
  
A day in the life  
Your day will be dynamic, strategic, and highly impactful. You might start by reviewing overnight fleet utilization data across MEATR markets, identifying a pattern of underutilization in one country and overdemand in another—prompting you to coordinate a cross-border vehicle transfer. You'll join a strategic planning session with Finance to present your updated 18-month fleet forecast, defending your assumptions and securing approval for a significant vehicle procurement order.  
Mid-morning, you'll dive into your forecasting model, adjusting parameters based on new network expansion plans shared by the Operations team, then run scenario analyses to understand the impact on CAPEX requirements.  
After lunch, you might review DSP feedback survey results, identifying a recurring theme about maintenance delays. You'll brainstorm solutions with the maintenance vendor and draft a proposal for a new preventive maintenance program. You'll then prepare for your afternoon executive business review, creating visualizations that tell a compelling story about fleet performance trends and your strategic recommendations.  
Late afternoon brings a call with regional fleet managers across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey—you're coaching them on a new audit framework and gathering their input on local market dynamics that should inform your demand forecast. You wrap up your day by analyzing repair cost trends, identifying an opportunity to consolidate vendors and save on OPEX.  
Throughout, you're the critical link ensuring our fleet remains reliable, safe, cost-efficient, and perfectly sized to meet customer demand—balancing analytical rigor with operational pragmatism and strategic thinking.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* 7+ years of management experience, small business logistics, or supply chain / planning experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Travel up to 50% of the time

**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.**

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.
