**Role Vision and Impact**

The Senior Director, Information Security and End-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

The mission of this strategic role is to **protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations.** The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the **Board of Directors (BoD),** the **Audit Committee,** the **CBC/Radio-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET)** and the **T&I Management Executive Team (MET).**

Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations**

* Develop, champion and execute an enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
* Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
* Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
* Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

  

**Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and** **Broadcast/Operational** **Technology (OT) Environments**

* Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
* Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

  

**Governance, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance**

* Drive a cybersecurity culture and awareness program focused on lasting behaviour change across the organization.

  

**Defence Operations, SOC and Crisis Management**

* Direct major security incident response operations and lead technology crisis management, from detection to full business recovery.
* Oversee regular penetration testing, vulnerability assessments and cyberattack simulation exercises across IT, broadcast and distribution environments.

**Financial Management and Team Engagement**

* Lead with the heart.

**Education and Certifications**

* At least one recognized executive-level professional certification: **CISSP, CISM, CCISO, CISA** or **CRISC**.

* Ability to provide collaborative leadership within the organization to see complex, transformational initiatives through to completion.

Title: Engineering Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead team of software engineers within the Engineering & E-commerce function. Own the delivery, quality and production reliability of the systems within the assigned domain, such as ordering, menu serving, payments, loyalty, aggregator integration, in-store technology or customer platforms. Turn approved priorities into working, reliable software, delivered on time and at a controlled cost. This enables the company to serve customers and locations across markets and grow digital sales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the assigned domain end to end - Own the architecture, roadmap execution, quality and production reliability of the domain’s systems and APIs. The scope of the domain will be assigned in writing by the line manager.
* Deliver the approved roadmap predictably - Define scope, estimate, sequence, manage risks and dependencies, and report status and trade-offs early, in line with the department’s software development lifecycle, so that commitments to the business are met.
* Own the system design and architecture of the domain - Propose designs and architecture changes and make technical trade-offs related to performance, resilience, data consistency, security, cost and time to market. Decisions must remain within the architecture principles and engineering standards established by the Director of Engineering & E-commerce and the engineering leadership.
* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.
* Act as custodian of the domain’s spend - Track cloud consumption, licences and contractor time. Identify and remove waste and raise cost risks early with the line manager. Commercial and budget decisions remain with the line manager and must follow company processes.
* Build, lead and grow a team of software engineers - Coach team members, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career development. Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.
* Align with peers and stakeholders before acting - Agree on interfaces, dependencies and priorities with other Engineering Managers, Product, Operations and business teams. Escalate disagreements to the line manager with clear options. Do not make unilateral decisions that change another team’s work, cost or risk.

**Leadership Requirements:**

* Ownership: Takes full accountability for the domain, its production systems and its people.
* Hands-on credibility: Designs systems and understands the code sufficiently to make sound technical decisions and coach engineers.
* AI-first mindset: Uses AI by default and leads the team to do the same.
* Delivery discipline: Plans realistically, commits carefully and keeps commitments.
* Calm under pressure: Leads clearly during incidents and peak periods.
* Decides through alignment: Works across team boundaries through agreement rather than authority.
* Financial responsibility: Treats company money responsibly in every technical decision.
* People development: Develops software engineers and builds a culture of engineering excellence.

**Major Challenges**

* Deliver new features while maintaining production stability.
* Manage dependencies on other teams and vendors that the role does not directly control.
* Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy systems while keeping the systems operational.
* Maintain delivery quality across a team comprising employees and external developers working in different locations.
* Migrate existing systems to the department’s standard programming language, Golang, while continuing ongoing delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Cloud or architecture certification is an advantage

**Experience:**

* Five or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade, high-availability systems
* Experience with consumer digital platforms within quick-service restaurants, retail, e-commerce, marketplaces or logistics is preferred
* Experience working with external developers, contractor teams or vendor teams is an advantage

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* System design and architecture: Service architecture, API design, data modelling, distributed systems, modern system design and cloud principles
* Programming: Golang is preferred. Java, C#, Node.js or PHP are accepted. Willingness to learn Golang and migrate systems to Golang is required
* Databases and caches: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis or Aerospike
* Messaging and streaming: Kafka and RabbitMQ
* Monitoring and reliability: Logs, metrics, traces, service-level objectives, alerting and incident response
* Performance: Profiling, load testing, latency optimisation and cost optimisation
* AI for engineering: Daily use of AI tools for development and the automation of other tasks
* Engineering quality: Automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, and secure coding.

**Generic Skills:**

* Clear communication and the ability to translate engineering details into business impact
* Stakeholder management
* Project management, including planning, estimation, risk management and dependency management
* Coaching and performance management

**Competencies:**

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ownership and accountability
* Delivery focus
* Collaboration and influence
* Developing people
* Customer focus
* Integrity

**Technical Competencies**

* System Design and Architecture: Advanced
* Backend Engineering: Advanced
* Reliability, Monitoring and Performance: Advanced
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Advanced
* Data Stores and Messaging: Advanced
* Cloud Principles: Intermediate

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)
Description:
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).

In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.

Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

* Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support

* Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues

This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. * Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

Title: Head of Digital Experiences
Description:
At Collectivus Holdings, we bring together some of the most recognized and loved brands across the collecting, trading card game, and hobby industries. Backed by a century of collective experience, we’re building what’s next through innovative products, exceptional quality, and unforgettable customer experiences.

Our teams and brands serve passionate communities around the world—and we’re looking for equally passionate people to help us grow.

  

**Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com/  
**Global Locations:** Aarhus - Dallas - Delhi - Lisbon - Nashville - Remote Worldwide

**Job Title:** Head of Digital Experiences

**Reporting Line:** CEO

  

Collectivus Holdings is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Digital Experiences to lead the vision, strategy, performance, and the ongoing evolution of our external-facing digital platforms across our portfolio of businesses.

This leader will oversee the digital product strategy and roadmap for our Learning Management System (LMS), Sorted app, and other customer-, retailer-, and partner-facing digital experiences.

The role is responsible for ensuring our digital products deliver meaningful value to users, support business objectives, and create a connected, intuitive experience across the Collectivus ecosystem.

Working closely with business leaders, Technology, Product, Sales, and Operations, this individual will translate business needs into clear digital priorities, partner on scalable software delivery and support processes, and drive measurable results.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Digital Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and own the enterprise-wide strategy for external-facing digital products and experiences.
* Establish a cohesive digital vision across Collectivus businesses while addressing the unique needs of each brand and customer segment.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retailer adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue through digital solutions.
* Build and manage a prioritized digital roadmap aligned with business objectives, available resources, and expected returns.
* Evaluate new digital opportunities, partnerships, and capabilities that support long-term business growth.

### **Digital Product Ownership**

Provide strategic direction and product leadership for key digital platforms, including:

* **Learning Management System (LMS):** Guide platform development, user experience, educational content delivery capabilities, community engagement, and adoption.
* **Sorted App:** Own the product vision, user experience, feature prioritization, and ongoing evolution of the platform.
* **Additional Digital Experiences:** Provide oversight and strategic alignment for other external-facing websites, applications, portals, and digital tools across the organization.
* Ensure each platform has a defined product strategy, roadmap, ownership structure, and measurable performance expectations.

### **Customer & Partner Experience**

* Champion a customer-first approach to digital product development.
* Ensure digital experiences are intuitive, reliable, accessible, and aligned with customer and partner needs.
* Use customer feedback, usage analytics, and market insights to inform product enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to create more connected experiences across platforms and business units.
* Partner with commercial teams to improve digital adoption, engagement, and customer retention.

### **Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, secure, reliable solutions, with clear accountability for product priorities, engineering execution, and business acceptance.
* Work with business leaders to understand priorities, evaluate requests, and establish clear product requirements.
* Lead product prioritization and make recommendations on resource allocation and investment.
* Establish clear product milestones, acceptance criteria, launch readiness expectations, and accountability for digital initiatives in partnership with delivery teams.
* Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful product development and launches.
* Identify and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Ensure new functionality is supported by appropriate launch, training, and adoption plans.
* Ensure each product has appropriate production-readiness criteria, monitoring, service expectations, documentation, and support arrangements before launch.
* Help establish a scalable keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) operating model for digital products, including service ownership, support processes, incident escalation, and ongoing enhancements.
* Define clear decision rights and handoffs among product, engineering, project delivery, and operations teams, including ownership of requirements, technical delivery, business acceptance, and production support.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

* Establish KPIs for each digital platform, including revenue and monetization where applicable, user adoption, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Own digital product operating budgets and develop business cases for new digital investments, including anticipated benefits, costs, and ROI.
* Monitor product performance and use data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Provide regular updates to executive leadership on roadmap progress, performance, risks, and investment needs.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing platforms and recommend where to invest, improve, consolidate, or discontinue functionality.

### **Team & Vendor Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing digital product function as business needs evolve.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes across digital initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and service providers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Digital Product Management, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, digital strategy, or platform leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple customer-facing digital products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of product development, user experience, platform integrations, and digital ecosystems.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, mobile applications, LMS platforms, or retailer-facing technology strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to develop digital roadmaps and translate business objectives into actionable product priorities.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, technical resources, and external development partners.
* Strong commercial acumen, including experience evaluating product investments, business cases, and ROI.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and customer insights to improve digital performance.
* Experience operating across multiple businesses, brands, or international markets preferred.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Strategic Thinking:** Connects digital capabilities to broader business priorities and long-term growth opportunities.
* **Execution & Accountability:** Translates strategy into measurable outcomes, clear ownership, and consistent delivery.
* **Customer Focus:** Understands the needs of retailers, partners, and end users and uses those insights to guide decisions.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Evaluates digital investments based on business value, adoption, cost, and return.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Builds alignment across business and technical teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* **Pragmatic Problem-Solving:** Balances innovation with business realities, prioritizing solutions that deliver meaningful results.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

Success in this role will be evaluated through:

* Delivery against an approved, prioritized digital product roadmap.
* Increased adoption and engagement across LMS, Sorted, and other digital platforms.
* Improved customer and partner experience, measured through feedback and product performance.
* Achievement of agreed commercial and operational KPIs for each platform.
* On-time delivery of key digital initiatives within approved budgets.
* Clear product ownership, prioritization, and accountability across the organization.
* Demonstrated business value and return on digital investments.

Title: Senior Engineering Manager Mobile Platform
Description:
**Description**

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

**About the Role:**

Realtor.com's mobile apps help millions of people each month search for, tour, finance, and move into their next home. The Mobile Platform team owns the shared foundations, tools, and standards that let our product teams ship quickly and confidently on iOS and Android.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead the iOS, Android, and tooling/build/release engineers on that team and treat the platform as a product. Internal mobile engineers are your customers, and you will measure success by their productivity, the quality and performance of our apps, and how quickly and safely we deliver value to consumers.

You are a technically credible leader who guides architecture through strong tech leads, builds a high-performing and inclusive team, and influences across the Consumer organization.

**Top Reasons to Apply:**

* **Lead a major mobile modernization initiative**. Help shape the future of Realtor.com's iOS and Android platforms, with the opportunity to influence architecture and long-term engineering strategy.
* **Manage a highly experienced engineering team.** Work alongside talented Staff and Senior Staff Engineers while focusing on technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic execution.
* **Make an impact across the entire mobile organization.** Build the tools and infrastructure that empower multiple feature teams to deliver better mobile experiences to hundreds of thousands of daily users.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Platform as a product:** Set the vision and multi-quarter roadmap, gather feedback from product teams, set adoption goals, and measure impact. Partner with Product, Design, and Mobile Product Engineering leaders to prioritize work.
* **Developer experience:** Own build systems, CI/CD, release automation, test infrastructure, and developer workflows. Improve release confidence with automation, feature flags, staged rollouts, and quality gates, and reduce duplication across iOS and Android with paved paths, templates, and documentation.
* **Shared capabilities:** Guide shared capabilities such as the design system, networking and data layer, authentication, analytics, experimentation, and SDKs. Set direction for app architecture and modularization on both platforms, and adopt cross-platform frameworks such as KMP or React Native where they make sense, respecting native conventions.
* **App health:** Own startup time, responsiveness, stability (crash and ANR rates), app size, accessibility, security, and privacy. Establish engineering standards and observability, lead incident response and root-cause analysis, and keep apps current with OS releases, store policies, and dependencies.
* **Leadership:** Lead, coach, and grow a team of 7 to 10 engineers, hiring and retaining top mobile talent. Work through tech leads and staff engineers to set technical direction and raise the bar. Build a culture of integrity, trust, quality, and continuous improvement, drive Agile incremental delivery, and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience shipping mobile apps
* 2-5 years leading engineering teams, tech leads, or senior and staff engineers
* Deep experience in one native ecosystem (iOS with Swift/SwiftUI or Android with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and working knowledge of the other; experience in both is strongly preferred
* A track record of treating a platform, shared library, or internal tooling as a product, with defined customers, roadmaps, adoption, and measurable outcomes
* Strong grasp of mobile architecture, modularization, testing, CI/CD, and release engineering, and experience improving app performance and quality at scale
* Ability to set technical direction through tech leads, make sound trade-offs, and hold teams accountable for quality
* A results-oriented mindset, excellent communication, and the ability to influence across teams without direct authority
* A proven record of coaching engineers and growing their careers, with empathy for our customers

**How We Work:**

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

**How We Reward You:**

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:

* Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
* Family forming benefits
* 13 Paid Holidays
* Flexible Time Off
* 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
* Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
* Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
* 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
* Free snacks and refreshments in each office location

**Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com**

Here, you'll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you'll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you'll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we'll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Senior Program Delivery Manager
Description:
Applause is seeking an experienced delivery leader to oversee a complex portfolio of digital quality services for a strategic enterprise customer. This person will serve as the senior connection point between customer stakeholders and Applause’s delivery organization, ensuring that testing programs are well governed, properly resourced, measurable, and aligned with agreed business outcomes.
  
  
The
**Senior Program Delivery Manager**
will provide unified oversight across testing workstreams, lead a team of Localization Quality Account Managers (LQAMs), and partner with Testing Services, Account Management, Community Operations, Product, and other internal teams. The role is accountable for the quality, consistency, and business value of Applause-delivered services.

Customer-side decisions—including internal strategy, policy, prioritization, organizational alignment, and program ownership—remain with the customer. The Senior Program Delivery Manager ensures that Applause understands those decisions and translates them into an effective service-delivery strategy.

**Responsilities**
**Program and Service Delivery**

* Own the overall governance and delivery health of a large, multifaceted digital quality engagement.

* Anticipate delivery risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and changes in customer demand; create and drive mitigation plans.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate a team of LQAMs responsible for day-to-day delivery across assigned workstreams.
* Establish clear roles, work allocation, performance expectations, communication standards, and escalation responsibilities.
* Coach team members on delivery strategy, customer communication, risk management, and executive-level value articulation.
* Balance resources and capacity across workstreams while maintaining continuity during periods of change, leave, or shifting priorities.
* Promote shared accountability and consistent delivery practices across the broader account team.

**Governance, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Establish and manage the engagement’s operating cadence, including delivery reviews, stakeholder updates, risk reviews, and executive governance.
* Ensure that program reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and supported by reliable data.
* Monitor and communicate service performance through meaningful KPIs, including testing coverage, delivery progress, quality trends, utilization, risks, and business outcomes.
* Lead preparation for quarterly business reviews and other executive-level presentations.
* Turn testing and delivery data into clear recommendations, insights, and decision-support for customer and Applause leadership.
* Ensure that action items, decisions, risks, and dependencies are documented and followed through to completion.

* Partner with the customer’s internal program lead to align Applause delivery with customer-defined priorities.

* Manage dependencies involving external partners or vendors when they affect Applause service delivery.
* Provide a clear escalation point for delivery challenges, cross-functional dependencies, and stakeholder concerns.
* Communicate effectively across operational, technical, and executive audiences.

**Account Health & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to increase service value, testing effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Account Management on scope management, renewals, and appropriate expansion opportunities.
* Capture repeatable practices and contribute them to Applause delivery standards.
* Reduce operational complexity and key-person dependency through documentation, standardization, and thoughtful delegation.

**Measures of Success**
**Success In This Role Will Be Demonstrated Through**

* Consistent achievement of delivery commitments and service levels.
* Strong customer confidence in Applause’s delivery organization.
* Accurate, decision-ready reporting and reliable executive-review preparation.
* Clear accountability across Applause, customer, and partner teams.
* Early identification and effective mitigation of delivery risks.
* Healthy utilization, capacity planning, and resource continuity.
* Effective leadership and development of the LQAM team.
* Measurable improvements in testing value, quality coverage, and operational efficiency.
* Appropriate separation between Applause service ownership and the customer’s internal program responsibilities.

**Essential Skills**

* Strong service-delivery and program-governance leadership in complex enterprise environments.

* Ability to build trusted customer relationships while maintaining clear organizational and commercial boundaries.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, presentation tools, reporting platforms, and remote collaboration systems.

**Qualifications**

* Eight or more years of experience in enterprise program delivery, implementation, consulting, managed services, or customer engagement leadership.

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
**About Blackbird Health**

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we're growing into new markets in 2027.

**Position Summary**

Blackbird Health is looking to hire a Technical Program Manager (TPM), Clinical Data & Operations to join our growing Data & Technology team. This role will own the end-to-end delivery of our clinical data initiatives—serving as the strategic engine for clinical operations. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data and Technology, you will translate complex operational bottlenecks (provider capacity, patient throughput, scheduling workflows) into scalable data products. Leveraging our modern cloud data stack (Snowflake, AWS, GCP, and dbt), you will define KPIs, eliminate manual reporting, and operationalize data so our clinics run as efficiently as possible. This is not a traditional TPM role. You won't just coordinate roadmaps or track deliverables; you will build analytics solutions from prototype to production partnering with respective experts in the organization.

**What makes you, you:**

* **Player-Coach Mentality:** You are comfortable leading projects strategically while also rolling up your sleeves to write SQL or build data models when needed to unblock your team.
* **Clarity of Thought:** You can translate ambiguous clinical and operational challenges into precise technical requirements and clear strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
* **Empathy & Integrity:** You lead with heart and high EQ, understanding the day-to-day stress of clinical directors and framing data as a tool to help them, not police them.
* **Operations Obsessed:** You don't just look at numbers; you deeply understand how clinics actually run in the real world and care about the human impact of your workflows.
* **Ambiguity Navigator:** You thrive when handed a vague business problem, quickly structuring it into a clear, actionable technical project and agile roadmap.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* **Technical Program Management & Delivery:** Own the data product roadmap for clinical operations; scope, prioritize, and drive the execution of complex data projects from initial concept to production delivery.
* Translate ambiguous clinical and operational challenges into precise technical requirements and data models.

* Track the operational and financial ROI of implemented data products and workflow adjustments over time.

* Ensure strict adherence to **HIPAA** compliance, data security, and patient privacy standards in all data models and reporting outputs.

**The basics you'll need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, data product management, or a senior analytics role heavily embedded in clinical operations.
* Deep, practical understanding of clinic operations (e.g., provider scheduling, utilization metrics, patient throughput).
* Strong understanding of modern cloud data warehouse architecture (specifically Snowflake, with exposure to AWS or GCP environments).
* Experience with or strong conceptual understanding of dbt (data build tool) for data modeling and pipeline transformation.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience with modern BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) to build compelling data narratives.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA regulations and data governance best practices in healthcare.
* Proficiency with agile methodologies and modern project tracking tools (Jira, Linear, Asana, etc.).

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with clinical interoperability standards and data formats, specifically HL7 and FHIR, as well as billing codes (ICD-10, CPT).
* Expert-level understanding of workflows within major Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis and predictive modeling.

**Why Blackbird is unique:**

* **High-Impact Ownership:** Direct opportunities to shape how our clinics run and directly improve the mental healthcare experience for families.
* **Modern Tech Stack:** Autonomy to build scalable solutions using best-in-class cloud and analytics engineering tools.
* **Leadership Impact:** You will report directly to technology leadership and act as a key liaison across the entire clinical organization.
* Supportive work culture

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage (available on day 1 of employment)
* 401k (with a company match)
* Employer-paid life insurance coverage
* Generous paid time off
* Opportunities for career growth

**Join us!**

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child's brain, body, and behavior work together.

"It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this-from testing to therapy to med management (and more)-all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone."

Title: eTrading Engineering Lead
Description:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in Canada. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.
  
  
In Canada, HSBC Global Services (Canada) Limited (HGCA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Global Services Limited. Operating in Toronto, HGCA is part of a global service company, delivering services to support the operating entities of HSBC Group. We have different capabilities that provide tools and processes to facilitate the functions, business, and entities with their service management responsibilities.
  
  
**Ready to shape the infrastructure behind low-latency electronic trading platforms?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join Markets and Securities Services Information Technology (IT) as Regional Head of electronic Trading (eTrading) Infrastructure Engineering in Toronto, Canada. This role owns the regional infrastructure engineering capability supporting latency-sensitive and collocated electronic trading platforms. You’ll manage two infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on across data center compute, Linux, server hardware, network switching, and exchange connectivity. You’ll take end-to-end accountability for the regional infrastructure delivery pipeline aligned to agreed business priorities, alongside operational service performance and the regional risk and control agenda. Success means resilient, secure, and cost-effective services, strong control outcomes, and well-governed delivery across collocated data centers and exchange-facing infrastructure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee and develop two infrastructure engineers, setting objectives, allocating work, and building succession and capability plans
* Own the regional delivery pipeline and roadmap, translating business priorities into committed plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes while managing dependencies and trade-offs
* Manage the regional infrastructure budget, forecasts, and investment cases, controlling capital and operating expenditure and supplier and hardware lifecycle decisions
* Govern service availability, capacity, resilience, and support readiness, coordinating incident, problem, change, and recovery through to permanent remediation
* Own the regional risk and control environment, including technology risk assessment, audit and regulatory actions, security and firmware compliance, evidence quality, and timely issue closure
* Design, build, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure across collocated and enterprise data centers including Linux platforms, physical servers, network switches, cabling, out-of-band management, and low-latency connectivity
* Define and maintain regional reference architectures, engineering standards, design blueprints, build patterns, and operational procedures aligned with global strategy
* Build repeatable infrastructure delivery and validation pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing, contributing production-quality Java and Ansible code
* Stakeholder management: Partner with trading business, application engineering, architecture, cyber security, operations, risk, finance, procurement, vendors, exchanges and carriers to deliver regional outcomes.
* Regional execution: Lead data-centre builds, migrations, refreshes and exchange onboarding, coordinating suppliers and remote-hands teams and providing hands-on support during critical implementations and incidents.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial hands-on experience in infrastructure, network, or compute engineering with accountability for regional or business-critical services
* Manage a small engineering team, establishing priorities, assuring delivery, and developing technical capability
* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management
* Use strong knowledge of low-latency networking including Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing and switching, multicast, packet capture analysis, and exchange or market data connectivity
* Build continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows and automated, version-controlled infrastructure delivery aligned to a Network Development and Operations (NetDevOps) approach
* Apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to infrastructure and network engineering using repeatable lab and pre-production validation
* Write production code in Java, or bring equivalent demonstrable production coding experience in Python or a comparable language
* Build Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible including reusable roles and playbooks, automated testing, and integration into delivery pipelines
* Experience supporting electronic trading, market-data or other latency-sensitive financial services infrastructure.
* Professional network certification such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center, or equivalent depth of experience.
* Experience with Docker, Containerlab, Molecule, Jira, Confluence and CI platforms such as TeamCity.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

**-**
-----

**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------

**About the Role:**

The Manager, Analytics Insights is a hands-on leader on our Advanced Analytics team. You will lead analytics workstreams on client engagements, guide and develop a small team of analysts, and turn complex data into clear recommendations for client teams. You will report to a Senior Manager or Partner and work closely with them on client delivery.

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead analytics workstreams from problem definition through to final deliverable, turning client questions into clear analytical approaches
* Build and review analyses, models, and dashboards, and check the team's work for accuracy and quality
* Manage workplans, timelines, and budgets, and raise risks early with Senior Managers and Partners
* Coach and develop analysts through day-to-day guidance, regular feedback, and input on staffing
* Present findings and recommendations to client teams (typically Director/VP level) and support Senior Managers and Partners in executive discussions
* Contribute to proposals, reusable tools, and methods that improve how the team delivers

**A Day in the Life:**

No two days are the same, but a typical day might look like this:

  

* Morning check-in: Hold a quick stand-up with your analysts to review progress, unblock issues, and set priorities for the day. Check the workplan and budget, and flag any risks to the Senior Manager or Partner.
* Hands-on analysis: Build or review analyses in SQL, Python, or Power BI, such as a customer retention and churn view, a pricing and volume analysis, or a revenue and margin bridge. Check the team's work for accuracy before it goes to the client.
* Client working session: Walk client teams through emerging findings, test assumptions, and agree next steps. Topics might include value creation opportunities, customer segments, or growth strategy.
* Coaching and team time: Give analysts feedback, review a draft deliverable, and help someone work through a modeling or data problem.
* Storyline and recommendations: Turn results into a clear, executive-ready message and prepare for an upcoming discussion with the Senior Manager or Partner.
* Team and firm contribution: Update the plan and budget, contribute to a proposal, or improve a reusable tool or method for the wider Advanced Analytics team.

**About the team**
------------------

Deloitte’s Analytic Insights team transforms data into actionable insights to support strategic decisions that amplify stakeholder value. The team relies on expertise in business understanding, data engineering, data science, and data visualization to drive value for clients. Our team is comprised of a mix of deep technical expertise in the statistical and analytics fields and business professionals with the experience to leverage insights to drive business decisions.

**Enough about us, let’s talk about you**
-----------------------------------------

**Experience & Leadership:**

  

* 4–6+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related field (e.g., business intelligence, financial or marketing analytics)\
* Experience leading workstreams and supervising analysts on client or multi-team projects
* Experience managing scope, timelines, and budgets, and escalating risks early
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., statistics, engineering, computer science, economics) or equivalent experience

**Client Engagement:**

  

* Experience advising client stakeholders (Director/VP level) on analytics-driven business decisions, with exposure to senior executives alongside engagement leadership
* Experience running working sessions and presenting findings to client teams and agreeing next steps

**Technical & Analytical Skills:**

  

* SQL and Python or R for data preparation, analysis, and modeling
* Power BI or Tableau for dashboards and data visualization
* Applied statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, forecasting, classification, and clustering; optimization or simulation is an asset
* Experience with a cloud data platform (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) and version control (e.g., Git)
* Strong habits around data quality, validation, and privacy, and the ability to turn results into a clear, actionable story that quantifies value

**Enterprise AI:**

  

* Practical experience with predictive AI and generative AI, and working knowledge of agentic AI and RAG-based systems
* Understanding of the model lifecycle (validation, monitoring, explainability) and responsible AI practices

**Communication & Teamwork:**

  

* Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, executive-ready language
* A track record of building trusted relationships with clients, colleagues, and internal stakeholders, and of mentoring analysts
* Solid business sense, with the ability to turn complex datasets into practical recommendations

**Nice to Have:**

  

* Master's degree or relevant certification (e.g., cloud, data, or AI)
* Experience in consulting, transaction or due diligence analytics, or a similar client-facing environment, including enterprise value creation (e.g., identifying and sizing revenue growth, margin, cost, and working capital opportunities) and customer and strategy analytics (e.g., segmentation, retention and churn, pricing, market and growth strategy)
* Exposure to MLOps or model deployment, and to change management for analytics or AI adoption

**Total Rewards**
-----------------

The salary range for this position is $101,000 - $169,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.  
  
Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Title: Technical Operations Center Manager
Description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
As a Technical Operations Center (TOC) Manager, you will be one of three global managers operating in a "Follow the Sun" model, ensuring continuous 24/7 coverage and operational excellence across our technical infrastructure. This role is accountable for more than ticket throughput. It turns operational signals into measurable reliability outcomes by strengthening service ownership, leading disciplined incident response, reducing repeat failure and toil, and moving the organization toward proactive, increasingly automated operations. Your leadership will be crucial in facilitating seamless handoffs between shifts, maintaining high performance, and upholding and improving they systems and processes that create operational drag.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Service Reliability & Operational Leadership
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Technical Operations Center, ensuring critical infrastructure and services are operated safely, reliably and consistently.
* Establish and maintain a service-centric operating rhythm covering service ownership, criticality, dependencies, SLOs/SLIs, incident trends, capacity, risk and operational readiness.
* Partner with service owners, engineering, cybersecurity, business technology teams and vendors to identify reliability risks before they become business-impacting incidents.
* Use observability, telemetry and service health data to improve detection, prioritization and decision-making.
* Maintain a regular operating review and publish a concise scorecard focused on outcomes rather than activity.

Major Incident Management & Swarming
  
  

* Lead or sponsor response to major incidents, acting as Incident Commander or ensuring the appropriate command structure is in place.
* Establish clear incident roles, escalation triggers, communication standards and decision rights for high-severity events.
* Make swarming repeatable through shared queues, structured triage-ready information and timely engagement of the right technical and business partners.
* Coordinate internal teams and third-party providers through restoration, stakeholder communication and service validation.
* Ensure blameless postmortems convert incident learning into prioritized problem-management, reliability and prevention work.

Problem Management, Toil Reduction & Automation
  
  

* Maintain a ranked backlog of repeat incidents, operational toil, alert noise and manual work, with owners and measurable outcomes.
* Drive the conversion of repeatable procedures into versioned runbooks, scripts, workflows, automation and self-service capabilities.
* Apply AI-assisted triage and knowledge discovery where appropriate, with human oversight, security controls, auditability and clear escalation paths.
* Improve the quality, findability and lifecycle management of operational knowledge, including runbooks, known-error records, as-builts and shift documentation.
* Track automation adoption and toil hours avoided using the results to redirect capacity toward reliability engineering and service improvement.

Change, Release & Operational Readiness
  
  

* Strengthen risk-tiered change practices, including pre-checks, peer review, testing evidence, implementation plans, monitoring and rollback readiness.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to shift operational readiness earlier in the lifecycle, including supportability, observability, runbooks and ownership before release.
* Analyze change-related incidents and failure patterns leading corrective actions that improve change success and reduce recovery time.
* Support paved-road standards and a transparent exception process for common infrastructure, cloud, identity, network and systems patterns.

Global Coordination & Follow-the-Sun Operations
  
  

* Facilitate structured handoffs between global teams, ensuring the incoming shift receives current service health, active incidents, risks, decisions, next actions and escalation needs.
* Maintain consistent severity, response, handoff, change and review practices across regions while respecting local context and coverage requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across time zones, technical domains, business units and strategic vendors.
* Participate in a rotating global coverage and escalation model, including occasional out-of-hours or weekend coverage when required. The schedule should support sustainable coverage rather than routine weekend office attendance.

People Leadership & Capability Building
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop Technical Operations Center specialists, creating a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Set clear expectations for performance, incident leadership, documentation, operational discipline and customer experience.
* Hire, onboard and develop talent while building role-based learning paths and cross-training plans for critical domains.
* Establish resilient coverage with documented SME and backup relationships, reducing key-person dependency.

**Skills/Abilities**
Job Requirements:
  
  

* Deep technical knowledge in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations or related disciplines.
* Ability to assess impact, prioritize under pressure, communicate clearly and make sound decisions during high-severity events.
* Experience with service ownership, observability, SLOs/SLIs, operational readiness, runbooks and reliability metrics.
* Experience reducing operational toil through scripting, workflow automation, self-service or similar engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of cloud, identity, network, systems and/or enterprise infrastructure operations.
* Ability to build trust across engineering, security, business technology, vendors and geographically distributed teams.
* Commitment to blameless learning, continuous improvement and inclusive people leadership.

**Experience**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations, IT service management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three or more years leading technical teams, major incident response, operational programs or cross-functional reliability initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical infrastructure or applications in a complex, globally distributed environment.
* Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service-level and knowledge-management practices.

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, work orders and subcontractor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes and repair dispatches based on technician qualifications, geography and priority.
* Monitor technician productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, parts availability and client communication for incomplete repairs.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site maintenance schedules, dispatch priorities and travel logistics across assigned territories.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective repairs within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, outages and repair delays; keep the client informed.
* Track work-order status, technician assignments, service dates and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with labor, parts, test results, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate repeat service calls, incomplete repairs and workmanship concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of used oil, filters, coolant, batteries and other service waste.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, troubleshooting, load testing and repairs at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing field preventive maintenance and generator repair programs with testing and QA documentation.
* Parts and materials management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, service scopes and warranties.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs, generator diagnostics, emergency repairs and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for generator outages, emergency repairs and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion and work-order closeout.
* Repair quote, dispatch and service response within contract requirements.
* Every service visit documented with required inspections, test results and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator uptime, reduced repeat failures and timely resolution of deficiencies.
* Low repeat-repair rates, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

* Strong Excel skills and experience with an inventory, ERP or work order system.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Background in aftermarket parts, remanufacturing or consignment and resale programs.
* Knowledge of EPA and DOT rules for fluids, batteries, hazardous materials and freight.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.

**Cat5 Resources**

The Project Manager leads Cat5’s preventive maintenance and fueling program for a national wireless infrastructure client, with a fleet made up mostly of portable generators. Operations – Generator Services

Director of Operations

Mostly on-site in North Texas, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

Full-time, exempt

* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.

* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.

* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.
* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.
* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.
* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.
* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.

* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.

* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.
* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.
* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.
* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.

* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.
