Title: VP ENTERPRISE APPS
Description:
Overview:

**Vice President, Enterprise Applications, IT General Financial**

**Full Time, 80 Hours Per Pay Period, Day Shift**

**Covenant Health Overview:**

Covenant Health is the region’s top-performing healthcare network with 10 hospitals, outpatient and specialty services, and Covenant Medical Group, our area’s fastest-growing physician practice division. Headquartered in Knoxville, Covenant Health is a community-owned integrated healthcare delivery system and the area’s largest employer. Our more than 11,000 employees, volunteers, and 1,500 affiliated physicians are dedicated to improving the quality of life for the more than two million patients and families we serve every year. Covenant Health is the only healthcare system in East Tennessee to be named a Forbes “Best Employer” seven times.

**Position Summary:**

The Vice President, Enterprise Applications provides executive leadership for the enterprise business applications that support Covenant Health’s financial operations, workforce systems, revenue cycle, contact center, service management, productivity tools, patient engagement, analytics, and corporate operational workflows. This role partners with system executives to set application strategy, strengthen governance, improve adoption, and ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value. The VP leads ERP/HCM and Revenue Cycle optimization while advancing standardization, integration, performance, and sustained operational improvement across the enterprise. Areas of oversight include HCM, ERP, Revenue Cycle, productivity and collaboration platforms, IT service management, consumer engagement platform integration, business analytics and development, and other enterprise applications that support the health system.

Responsibilities:

* Lead systemwide strategy, standardization, optimization, and lifecycle management for enterprise application solutions across platforms.
* Provide executive oversight for Revenue Cycle applications supporting acute and ambulatory venues — including patient access, middle revenue cycle (HIM/coding/CDI), and back-end billing, collections, and denials — in partnership with Finance and Revenue Cycle operational leaders.
* Direct the enterprise HCM and ERP application strategy in close partnership with Finance, Human Resources, and Supply Chain leadership, advancing workflow efficiency, reporting accuracy, and end-user experience.
* Oversee the enterprise productivity and collaboration platform strategy, including communication, collaboration, information governance, and end-user adoption.
* Direct the IT service management platform strategy, ensuring effective service delivery, workflow automation, case management, and cross-functional operational efficiency.
* Oversee legal, compliance, and contract lifecycle management applications, ensuring regulatory adherence, auditability, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee enterprise business analytics, reporting, and application development capabilities that enable self-service reporting, financial and operational insight, and custom solutions aligned to corporate priorities.
* Establish and lead business application governance, including intake, prioritization, change control, roadmap alignment, and lifecycle planning in collaboration with senior leaders and IT governance committees.
* Serve as executive leader for major enterprise application implementations, integrations, upgrades, conversions, acquisitions, and modernization initiatives.
* Shared enterprise AI accountability, including team priorities, standards, intake, governance, evaluation, implementation, adoption, and performance measurement for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead enterprise vendor and managed services relationships for assigned enterprise application platforms, including scope, service levels, performance, escalation management, contract adherence, and value realization.
* Direct operational performance, optimization, and sustainment of enterprise application investments, including production stability, release management, workflow improvement, and end-user support.
* Develop annual operating budgets and long-term capital plans for assigned areas; ensure disciplined financial stewardship and ROI tracking on major initiatives.
* Provide executive program leadership for high-impact application initiatives, including revenue cycle transformation, ERP/HCM modernization, contact center modernization, enterprise productivity, service management enablement, analytics, and application development priorities.
* Lead HR activities for staff, including hiring, coaching, development, career pathing, and performance management across directors, managers, supervisors, analysts, developers, and support teams.
* Develop application roadmaps, delivery milestones, and organizational change management strategies.
* Align corporate application initiatives with consumerism and workforce strategies to elevate the patient financial experience, consumer experience, and employee experience.
* Oversee enterprise application education, adoption, and success metrics, including a network of super users and business champions across service lines.
* Follows policies, procedures, and safety standards. Completes required education assignments annually. Works toward achieving goals and objectives, and participates in quality improvement initiatives as requested.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

**Minimum Education:**

Master’s degree or equivalent experience will be considered.

**Minimum Experience:**

Minimum ten (10) years of progressive leadership experience in enterprise applications within a multi-facility healthcare environment.

**Licensure Requirement:**

None

Title: Consulting Principal, EHR/EMR COE Lead (Healthcare)
Description:
### **About Cognizant Consulting**

Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice. We’re a global community of 5,000+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their businesses. Blending our deep industry knowledge with technology advisory capabilities, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. Now, we’re looking for our next colleague to join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you?

### **About the role**

As an **Associate Director, EHR/EMR Center of Excellence Lead**, you will establish and lead Cognizant’s Provider EHR/EMR Center of Excellence, with an initial focus on Epic and Oracle Health solutions.

You will develop market-relevant EHR/EMR offerings, reusable delivery assets, implementation methods, and AI-enabled solutions that strengthen Cognizant’s healthcare provider consulting capabilities. You will work collaboratively with healthcare consulting leaders, account teams, delivery organizations, technology partners, and clients to shape opportunities and deliver complex EHR transformation programs.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Establish and lead the Provider EHR/EMR Center of Excellence, setting its strategic direction, operating model, capability roadmap, and standards for delivery excellence.
* Develop EHR/EMR consulting, implementation, optimization, and managed-services offerings, initially focused on Epic and Oracle Health, with expansion into MEDITECH, Altera, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and other platforms.
* Build reusable accelerators, assessment frameworks, playbooks, delivery methods, and AI-enabled solutions that improve implementation quality, speed, adoption, and measurable client outcomes.
* Lead EHR/EMR pursuits from qualification through contract execution, including solution development, proposals, presentations, pricing, staffing models, estimates, and statements of work.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of certified EHR/EMR consultants while building a sustainable certification pipeline across priority applications and modules.
* Provide executive oversight for complex EHR/EMR engagements, maintaining accountability for scope, governance, financial performance, delivery quality, risk management, and client satisfaction.
* Develop strategic relationships with EHR vendors, technology partners, and healthcare ecosystem organizations to strengthen market credibility and create new business opportunities.

### 

### **Work model**

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States, with some travel involved. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. They may change based on the project you are engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

### **What you must have to be considered**

* At least 15 years of experience in healthcare information technology, consulting, professional services, or technology-enabled transformation, including at least eight years leading EHR/EMR delivery initiatives.
* Active Epic certification in at least one application or module and/or a relevant Oracle Health certification.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple full-cycle EHR/EMR implementations, from strategy and planning through deployment, stabilization, optimization, and transition to support.
* Proven experience developing EHR/EMR solutions, proposals, pricing models, staffing plans, statements of work, and executive-level client presentations.
* Bachelor’s degree and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, manage senior client and vendor relationships, and maintain accountability for complex healthcare technology engagements.

### **These will help you succeed**

* Experience establishing or leading an EHR/EMR Center of Excellence, healthcare technology practice, or enterprise clinical transformation capability.
* Knowledge of multiple EHR platforms, including Epic, Oracle Health, MEDITECH, Altera, athenahealth, and eClinicalWorks.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, or generative AI to EHR implementation, optimization, clinical workflows, or managed services.
* A strong understanding of healthcare provider operations, clinical workflows, interoperability, data migration, application integration, adoption, and change management.
* A Master of Health Administration, Master of Business Administration, or another relevant advanced degree.

We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you meet only the minimum requirements listed. Consider the transferable experiences and unique skills that could help you bring something new and valuable to this role.

### 

### **Compensation**

**$165,000-$194,000**

This position is eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401(k) plan and contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Employee assistance program
* 10 paid holidays plus paid time off
* Paid parental leave and fertility assistance
* Learning and development certifications and programs

Title: Vice President of Product
Description:
**Job Summary**:

The Vice President of Product is accountable for the success of Tideworks' product portfolio: product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer adoption, product lifecycle management and the business outcomes delivered through Tideworks' products. The Vice President of Product owns what Tideworks builds and why. Reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, the Vice President sets product strategy across the marine and intermodal rail portfolios, leads the product management organization  
(value stream managers, product managers, product owners, UX and data science), and runs the roadmap as a commitment to customers.

The role builds on deep product knowledge and long customer relationships and brings the product management discipline a growing software company needs: discovery with customers, design before build, business cases, competitive positioning and pricing. The VP sits on the product and technology leadership team and partners closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, Professional Services and Engineering. The first priority is modernizing the existing product suite while keeping customers successful, with AI, analytics and automation an explicit part of the product strategy.

The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of terminal operations and the software that runs them, a track record of building a product management practice, and executive presence with customers, partners and a board.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Product Strategy and Portfolio**  
● Own the product strategy and portfolio across marine and rail: where Tideworks invests, where it holds, and the long-term direction of the product suite  
● Define the product vision with the CPTO and bring it to the executive team and the board with the evidence behind it  
● Own competitive positioning and the market view that informs it  
● Own product investment priorities: propose where roadmap capacity and investment go, with a business case and an expected outcome for each, and report results in adoption, revenue, customer value and operational improvement  
● Identify new market opportunities and adjacent segments for the product suite

**Product Modernization**  
● Lead the modernization of the existing products: evolve the architecture with the CPTO and Engineering, sequence modernization against new capability, and balance innovation with technical debt reduction  
● Keep customers successful through the transition: upgrade paths, compatibility and clear communication of what changes and when

**AI, Analytics and Automation**  
● Make AI, analytics, optimization and automation an explicit part of the product strategy: where they create value in terminal operations, the data foundations they need, and proposals with business cases  
● Partner with Engineering on AI-assisted development so product decisions keep pace with faster delivery

**Product Management Organization**  
● Lead the product management organization: value stream managers, product managers, product owners, UX and data science  
● Set role expectations at each level, coach, hire and develop the team, and propose the structure needed to deliver the strategy  
● Run the product leadership cadence and represent product in company planning

**Product Management Discipline**  
● Establish customer discovery as standard practice, with product managers in front of terminal operators and their teams  
● Require end-to-end design with UX ahead of development, a clear definition of done, and a business case for every significant investment  
● Define the metrics that tell us a release worked and review them after every major release

**Roadmap and Planning**  
● Publish a roadmap cycle customers can plan around, and run customer advisory groups for marine and rail  
● Agree with Engineering the allocation of capacity between roadmap, maintenance and  
customer projects, and hold the line on it  
● Lead product’s part of quarterly planning with the development and quality engineering teams

**Platform and Architecture Partnership**  
● Set platform direction with the CPTO and architecture: extensibility and configurable  
workflows, a consistent API surface across products, and product behaviour that holds together across the suite  
● Put an architecture and design review in front of new capabilities and services

**Commercial Accountability and Partnership**  
● Own competitive positioning and win themes with the Chief Revenue Officer, and support RFP responses and gap analyses  
● Agree scope and packaging with Professional Services for implementations and upgrades  
● Bring pricing and packaging recommendations to the executive team  
● Share accountability with the Chief Revenue Officer for revenue growth, customer retention and expansion, and bring new market opportunities to the executive team

**Strategic Customer and Partner Relationships**  
● Build executive relationships with key customers, global terminal operators and partners  
alongside the Chief Revenue Officer, who owns the commercial relationship; help shape long-term opportunities and bring them into the portfolio

**Product Analytics and Customer Insight**  
● Instrument usage and adoption in the products and maintain a product view of customer  
satisfaction, and measure product success through adoption, revenue, customer value and  
operational improvements  
● Turn customer feedback, support themes and sales findings into prioritized product work

**Qualifications:**  
● Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience  
● 12+ years of enterprise software product management, including 6+ years leading product leaders (managers of product managers)  
● Domain experience in terminal operating systems or the industry around them: marine  
terminals, intermodal rail, port logistics; experience in both marine and rail strongly preferred  
● A track record of building a product management practice (discovery, design, pricing, roadmap) with the artifacts and results to show for it  
● Experience taking a mature, installed enterprise product through a modernization or platform transition while keeping customers successful  
● Executive presence with customers, partners and a board, and experience in a growth-investor environment  
● Technical fluency: APIs, data models, integration (EDI and messaging) and cloud deployment  
● Experience bringing AI, analytics or automation into an enterprise product  
● Executive relationships with terminal operators and industry partners  
● Leads through managers, sets clear expectations, decides on evidence, and has led teams across time zones  
● Preferred: Class 1 railroad or intermodal operations experience; configurable or low-code  
workflow products; Spanish; product investment or P&L ownership

Pay: $250,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

* Location: remote or hybrid with travel up to 20% percent to customer sites

* **Speed:** You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week

Title: Director of Information Technology

Description:
**Position Summary:**

The Director of Information Technology leads the Firm’s day-to-day end-user technology operations and is accountable for delivering a secure, reliable, and service-focused technology experience to attorneys, business professionals, and clients. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Director oversees end-user computing, the Service Desk, onsite and remote technical support, and conference room audio visual technology, document management, IT project management, legal and business application integration, and endpoint asset and vendor management. The Director partners with Information Security, Innovation, Technology Engineering & Operations, and practice leadership to evaluate and adopt technologies, including AI, that improve client service and firm efficiency.

This is an in-office leadership role. The Director is expected to be visibly present in the office, lead the IT team in person, and set the standard for excellence, responsiveness, and accountability across the department.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership and Strategy**

* Partners with the Chief Information Officer and the senior IT leadership team to develop and execute the Firm’s IT strategy, multi-year technology roadmap, and annual operating and capital budgets, aligned with Firm priorities.
* Leads, hires, develops, and retains a high-performing IT team, spanning the Service Desk, onsite technical and AV support, Desktop Engineering, Project Management and Applications staff; sets clear goals, conducts performance reviews, and builds succession and career paths.
* Establishes and reports on key performance indicators and service levels (e.g., response and resolution times, first-contact resolution, system availability, user satisfaction) to the CIO and Firm leadership.
* Builds a culture of high-touch client service, accountability, and continuous improvement within the IT department.
* Partners with the broader IT leadership team to oversee IT governance, including project intake and prioritization, change management, and ITIL-aligned service management processes.

**Service Delivery and End-User Experience**

* Oversees the Service Desk and on-site support in all offices, including high-touch support for partners and executives and after-hours and on-call coverage.
* Directs modern endpoint and mobile device management (e.g., Microsoft Intune and Autopilot), including device standards, imaging, patching, encryption, and hardware refresh cycles.
* Ensures reliable conference room, hybrid meeting, and trial and courtroom technology support.
* Oversees technology onboarding and offboarding for new hires and lateral partners, and ensures effective end-user training and documentation.

**Legal and Business Applications**

* Oversees support, integration, and optimization of core legal platforms, including document management (e.g., iManage or NetDocuments), financial and practice management (e.g., Aderant or 3E), time entry, conflicts and intake (e.g., Intapp), CRM (e.g., InterAction), e-billing, and litigation support tools.
* Manages the full application lifecycle, including requirements, evaluation, testing, deployment, upgrades, integration, and retirement.
* Partners with Innovation, Finance, and practice groups to identify and deliver technology that improves attorney efficiency and client service.

**AI and Innovation**

* Partners with the Innovation team, Information Security, the Office of the General Counsel , and Risk Management to support the secure deployment, adoption, and support of generative AI and legal technology tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot and legal AI platforms).
* Contributes to the Firm’s AI governance efforts by supporting acceptable-use standards, data protection practices, vendor reviews, and the measurement of adoption and value.
* Identifies opportunities for automation and process improvement across the Firm.

**Cybersecurity, Risk, and Compliance**

* Partners with Information Security to implement and maintain security controls, including multi-factor authentication, endpoint detection and response, vulnerability and patch management, privileged access management, and data loss prevention.
* Supports client security audits and questionnaires, outside counsel guideline requirements, cyber insurance requirements, and alignment with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST.
* Participates in incident response and ensures IT practices comply with Firm policies, privacy and data protection requirements, and records retention and legal hold obligations
  **.**

* Manages IT budgets and forecasts with strong fiscal discipline.
* Partners with the Senior IT Business Manager to negotiates and manage contracts, licensing, and service levels with technology vendors and service providers, including vendor risk assessments.
* Maintains accurate hardware and software asset inventories, license compliance, and lifecycle management.
* Maintains current documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base content, and communicates technology changes clearly to attorneys and staff.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years in an IT leadership role managing managers and technical teams.
* Law firm or professional services experience strongly preferred (Am Law 200 preferred).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, and enterprise networking.
* Experience supporting legal applications such as document management, financial and practice management, and conflicts and intake systems.
* Proven track record leading enterprise technology projects (e.g., cloud migration, endpoint modernization, application upgrades).
* Experience managing IT budgets, vendor contracts, and IT asset management.
* Experience supporting client security audits and security and compliance frameworks.
* Executive presence and the ability to build trusted relationships with partners and Firm leadership.
* Strong service orientation and commitment to excellence.

* Sound understanding of cybersecurity principles and controls.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical topics to non-technical audiences.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage conflict and maintain a positive, high-performance team environment.
* Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and handle competing priorities.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience considered

**Certifications / Licenses**

* Preferred certifications include: ITIL 4 Foundation; Microsoft 365 or Azure (e.g. Enterprise Administrator, Azure Administrator; PMP

Title: Manager, Critical Situations
Description:
**Job Description**
The CriSit Manager owns the resolution of high-severity customer situations on Sapiens delivery engagements: major defects, stalled implementations, data issues, and at-risk programs where the customer relationship is under threat. They are the single point of accountability from the moment a CritSit is declared to the moment it is closed.
  
  
The role sits in Delivery success and has no direct reports. Results come through program management discipline, clear communication, and influence across Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success. It also calls for character as much as capability: customers and colleagues take their cue from how the Manager behaves under pressure.
  
  
**Job Requirements**

* Program management expertise, including recovering troubled programs through planning, risk and issue management, governance, and change control.
* Seven or more years in customer-facing technology, incident, or escalation roles, with first-hand experience as an Incident Commander or crisis lead.
* A track record of owning high-impact outages and severe escalations from first report to close-out, running the war room and mobilizing teams with no reporting line.
* Working knowledge of insurance or financial-services core systems, enough to judge business impact.
* Clear, accurate communication with customers and senior leaders at every level, with expectations set early.
* Practical experience using AI tools to improve incident management.
* Fluent English.
* Availability for the after-hours on-call rotation, and for travel to customer sites at short notice.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

The following are an advantage:
  

* Experience of the Insurance or financials platforms.
* ITIL major-incident practice.
* A further European language.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification.

**Job Responsibilities**
Critical Situation Ownership

* Own high-impact outages and severe escalations from first report to close-out, as the single point of accountability.
* Triage and validate escalations against the agreed severity and impact criteria.
* Stand up and run the war room, including bridge calls and a dedicated Slack or Teams channel, with the right stakeholders.
* Set priorities, owners, and action plans, and track them to completion.

Program and Delivery Recovery

* Agree a recovery plan within days of declaration, with clear milestones, dependencies, and exit criteria.
* Manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, and re-baseline scope and timelines with the customer and Delivery leads where needed.
* Agree resourcing with Delivery leadership, and raise gaps early.
* Hold program governance, such as regular checkpoints and steering updates, until the customer is back on track.

Communication and Stakeholder Management

* Give customers, customer executives, and Delivery Success leadership clear, accurate, regular updates, and set expectations early.
* Translate technical detail into clear business impact and next steps, drawing on knowledge of insurance and financial-services core systems.
* Support senior customer conversations alongside Delivery leadership.
* Escalate to Business leadership when a decision on resourcing, remediation, or commitments is beyond agreed limits.

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Mobilize Engineering, CloudOps and DevOps, Support, and Product resources, and remove blockers.
* Keep Sales, Customer Success, and Account Management aligned on status and customer impact.
* Lead the cross-functional working team through influence, without formal line authority.

Root Cause and Continuous Improvement

* Drive root-cause analysis, write the customer-facing report, and complete the post-mortem.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are logged, owned, and delivered, and hand recurring failures to the owning group with playbook changes.
* Identify patterns across engagements, releases, and components, and share them with Delivery, Product, and Engineering.
* Report on CritSit metrics: time to engage, mitigate, and resolve; repeat incidents; open CritSit volume and ageing; and recovery plan milestone adherence.

Title: Manager - Software Engineering
Description:
**Job Description Summary**
This role is accountable for L4 escalation outcomes across the AIS Digital Verisound and Imaging 360 product family. It covers complex customer escalations, defect triage and resolution, root cause analysis, and reducing recurring issues through improved observability, monitoring and permanent fixes.
  
  
The role also builds technical capability across L4 engineers, product experts and L3 support through training, knowledge sharing and consistent processes. It works with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Quality and Regulatory, Cybersecurity and Services to resolve issues on time and to scale support as the portfolio and installed base grow.
  
  
**Job Description**
Roles and responsibilities
  
  
Own L4 escalation outcomes
  
  

* Evaluate incidents raised by L3, confirm they are valid production issues, and assign each to the right L4 engineer by product and region, with a named owner until closure.
* Reproduce, debug and resolve complex and high-severity issues across the stack: application code, logs, databases, cloud services, networking and integrations.
* Settle severity and priority disagreements with L3 and remove cross-functional blockers.
* Drive resolution within severity-based targets, with disciplined management of cases on hold.

Reduce escalations at the source
  
  

* Improve observability, monitoring and alerting so problems are detected and diagnosed before customers report them.
* Work with Engineering to fix recurring issues at the root cause.
* Automate diagnostics, routine fixes and runbooks to cut manual effort and time to resolve.
* Define, design and implement benchmarks to catch performance regressions and bottlenecks. Agree acceptable performance parameters with Product Management and run performance and scalability testing across the tech stack.

Drive quality and reliability
  
  

* Hands on and lead defect triage and resolution. Make sure confirmed defects are recorded in the defect systems and classified with Engineering and the design review board.
* Lead root cause analysis for high-severity and recurring issues, and track preventive actions to completion.
* Spot trends across products (defect inflow, recurring issues, reopened cases) and feed them back to Product, Architecture and Engineering.

Build team capability
  
  

* Develop and deliver technical training on products, architecture and troubleshooting for L4 engineers, product experts and L3 support.
* Provide technical guidance on complex cases and review RCAs.
* Build and maintain a searchable knowledge base, short how-to articles and a list of top recurring issues and their fixes.
* Run a weekly knowledge-transfer session with L3 so more issues are resolved before they reach L4.
* Maintain onboarding material for new team members and support succession planning.
* Serve as a best-practice and quality resource and stay current on technical developments in the area.

Build the operating model
  
  

* Establish one consistent L4 process across all product lines, with a single RACI, RCA standard and KPI set.
* Define and report metrics such as mean time to resolve, aged cases, hold time, reopen rate, recurring issues and volume by product and region.
* Define the coverage model (regions, backups and high-severity response) and plan capacity as the installed base grows.

Communicate and govern
  
  

* Be the single voice for external and stakeholder communication on L4 escalations, with a consistent update cadence by severity, and provide US time zone leadership.
* Own the weekly operating rhythm: the stakeholder report and the program review of SLA, new, on-hold and resolved cases, flagging items that need leadership help or a decision.
* Explain difficult or sensitive technical information clearly and build consensus across functions.

Work responsibly in a regulated environment
  
  

* Make sure incidents with possible patient-safety implications are documented and routed to the owning channels under established procedures.
* Follow applicable quality, security and privacy requirements, and keep team training and required compliance current.

Scope and judgment
  
  

* Uses judgment to solve moderately complex technical and operational problems, takes new perspectives on existing solutions, and uses data analysis to support recommendations.
* Has in-depth knowledge of best practices and how the area integrates with others, and contributes to strategy and policy for L4 and reliability engineering.
* Leads small projects with moderate risk and resource needs, and acts as a resource for less experienced colleagues.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 6 years of experience in the Job Family Group or Function).
* Experience in site reliability, sustaining engineering or production support of complex software products, including cloud or SaaS products.
* Troubleshooting and debugging skills across application code, logs, databases, cloud services and networking.
* Track record of managing escalations, root cause analysis, and defect triage and resolution.
* Experience training or mentoring engineers.
* Experience with incident management tools (for example ServiceNow) and defect tracking systems.
* Clear communication with technical and executive audiences under pressure; comfortable working across time zones.

Desired characteristics
  
  

* 6 or more years in software engineering, site reliability or sustaining engineering.
* Medical device or other regulated software experience (for example FDA, ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 practices).
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools (for example Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or ELK) and with AWS or Azure.
* Scripting and automation skills (for example Python, PowerShell or Bash).
* Familiarity with imaging or digital fleet products, DevOps practices and cybersecurity.
* Experience developing training material or knowledge bases.
* ITIL or similar service-management knowledge; Lean and Heartbeat problem-solving.
* Strong oral and written communication, interpersonal and leadership skills; proven ability to analyze and resolve problems, and to plan, document and execute programs. Established project management skills.

* Ensure timely and effective resolution of customer technical issues, providing escalation management and technical guidance when necessary.
* Monitor service performance indicators, including response times, service completion, productivity, customer satisfaction, and service quality.
* Optimize resource allocation, scheduling, and service coverage to meet customer needs and operational objectives.
* Ensure service activities are accurately documented and performed in accordance with established procedures, quality standards, and safety requirements.

* Ensure customer commitments and service contract entitlements are understood, tracked, and consistently fulfilled.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, instrument reliability, and overall service experience.
* Collaborate with Sales, Technical Support, Applications, and other internal teams to deliver effective solutions and strengthen customer partnerships.

* Identify opportunities to expand service relationships, support contract renewals, and promote service offerings that deliver customer value.
* Analyze service performance metrics to identify trends, address operational challenges, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Lead initiatives to improve service efficiency, engineer productivity, process consistency, and customer outcomes.
* Support the implementation of organizational service strategies, business objectives, and operational best practices.

**Requirements**

**How You Will Get Here**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Business, or a related field, combined with a minimum of 5 years of relevant technical service experience in analytical instrumentation, laboratory equipment, or a related industry.
* Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, and relevant military experience may be considered - AS + 7 years or HS/GED + 9 years

* Proven experience managing service operations, developing technical teams, and driving operational performance.
* Demonstrated success supporting business growth, achieving revenue objectives, and managing service-related financial performance.
* Experience managing customer relationships, resolving escalated technical issues, and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Proven ability to implement service strategies, improve operational processes, and drive measurable performance improvements.

* Demonstrated leadership capabilities with a passion for coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance customer needs, operational efficiency, and financial objectives.
* Excellent customer relationship management, communication, negotiation, and problem-resolution skills.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
* Ability to interpret operational performance metrics and translate findings into actionable improvement initiatives.
* Proficiency with customer relationship management (CRM) platforms, such as SAP Cloud for Service or Salesforce, Microsoft Office applications, and service management systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, technical personnel, and cross-functional leadership.
* Ability to work independently, make sound business decisions, and lead teams in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Title: Senior Program Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATR DSP Strategy, Planning and Expansion
Description:
**Description**
Customers want what they need in minutes, not days. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to shape how our fastest delivery services, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, grow and run for customers, delivery associates, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Amazon.
  
  
As Senior Program Manager, you will own and lead the strategic programmes that set how our Speed last mile network runs across the region. At the core is flexible capacity: designing models that let DSP capacity move up and down with demand, setting how they fit into annual and weekly planning, and getting Operations, Finance, People teams and DSP partners behind them. Your portfolio may also cover partner commercials, compliance and training, and it will change as priorities change.
  
  
Many problems won't arrive well defined. You will frame them, find the ones worth solving, align senior stakeholders on a path forward and build mechanisms that make the answers scale across countries. You will also help shape the team's wider strategy and roadmap.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Set the strategy: own the multi-year capacity and growth plan for Quick Commerce and Speed, and the region's input to annual planning.
* Plan capacity: within the regional plan, build short, mid and long range plans that match DSP and delivery associate supply to demand by hour, day and season.
* Build flexible capacity: design, launch and scale flexible models alongside the fixed DSP network, with the operating, commercial and compliance framework to run them.
* Grow the channel: launch new cities, stores and countries with capacity ready before go-live.
* Improve efficiency: raise utilisation and lower cost per delivery without moving cost onto DSPs or associates.
* Build partner economics: shape DSP commercial models with Finance that work at every volume level, and lead the trade-off decisions.
* Look after delivery associates: design fair, safe, compliant schedules and lead the regional response to labour rule changes.
* Align and lead change: bring Operations, Finance, People, Legal, Tech and DSPs behind one plan, and run readiness and approvals.
* Build mechanisms: set planning tool requirements with Tech, and the metrics, guardrails and reviews that run the channel, using automation and AI.
* Lead and write: influence senior leaders, mentor PMs and analysts, and write documents that drive decisions.

A day in the life
  
  
You start with yesterday's Quick Commerce and Speed performance: where capacity matched demand, where routes ran short or associates sat idle, and what it cost. Mid-morning, you join the weekly planning review to agree where flexible capacity steps in next week. You then meet a DSP owner to test a new flexible model against their margin and their associates' hours. After lunch, you work with Finance and Legal on the case for scaling it to a second country. You end the day writing for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.
  
  
**About The Team**
This is a new role reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATr DSP. Quick Commerce and Speed, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, are delivered by DSPs, and flexible capacity is a lead theme in the region's 2027 plan. You will own Speed capacity and flexible capacity programmes across the region, planning inside the regional capacity plan and working with the Network Optimisation team, who own rate cards. You will mentor PMs and analysts and write planning papers reviewed at Director and VP level.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

**Role:** Manager, Software Development

The Manager, Software Development leads the newly formed engineering team delivering the Image& Fax Aviator Platform. This first-line manager will recruit, onboard, coach, and directly manage software engineers and technical specialists working across Java-based cloud services, Python-based AI and document intelligence, React user experiences, enterprise integrations, and platform operations. * Own day-to-day execution across one or more Scrum teams and translate roadmap priorities into credible sprint and release plans.

**We're looking for our next Senior Manager, JSOC & Threat Hunting**

The Senior Manager, JSOC & Threat Hunting is a hands-on technical leader accountable for security monitoring, incident response, threat hunting and intelligence, detection and security engineering, vulnerability management and DevSecOps across Questrade Financial Group's regulated entities. She/he leads the Joint Security Operations Centre (JSOC) as a 24x7, multi-shift operation spanning three teams (SOC and Incident Response, Threat Operations and Engineering, and DevSecOps), owns the JSOC service catalogue, and remains directly involved in major incidents, complex investigations, detection design, SIEM optimization and security tooling decisions. This is not a coordination-only leadership role. The role operates in a dual regulatory environment covering CIRO regulated dealer and wealth entities and OSFI regulated federal financial institutions, and is the senior escalation point for cyber incident detection, containment and the incident inputs required for regulator reporting.

**The mandate**

In this role, you will:

* Lead the Joint Security Operations Centre as a highly technical, hands-on leader across three teams: SOC and Incident Response, Threat Operations and Engineering, and DevSecOps. Remain directly involved in complex investigations, high-severity incidents, detection design, SIEM optimization and security tooling decisions, and challenge technical assumptions rather than rely on tool-generated conclusions.
* Own and maintain the JSOC service catalogue across three service lines (SOC/IR, Threat Operations, and DevSecOps), with defined service levels, a named owner and a named backup for every service line.
* Run alert monitoring and response as a continuous, multi-shift operation across five countries, ensuring coverage, shift handover discipline and consistent investigation quality across regions and time zones.
* Own the incident management lifecycle end to end, including severity classification, escalation paths, playbooks, evidence handling and chain of custody, containment, remediation, recovery and lessons learned. Provide technical direction from triage through closure on major incidents and lead cross-functional coordination with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, identity, fraud, privacy, legal and business teams.
* Ensure incident detection, classification and evidence are sufficient to meet OSFI technology and cyber security incident reporting expectations, including the 24-hour initial notification, and CIRO cybersecurity incident reporting obligations. Label every incident to the correct entity and regime and provide timely, accurate inputs to the Global Security Office, Legal, Privacy and Compliance.
* Oversee the design, testing, tuning and lifecycle management of detection rules and alerts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Improve SIEM effectiveness by reducing noise and false positives, optimising queries and ensuring alerts are actionable, and maintain a measured view of detection coverage and known gaps.
* Develop and run a proactive threat hunting program covering employee-facing and client-facing threats, informed by threat intelligence, attacker behaviours, environmental risk and observed detection gaps. Convert hunt findings into durable detections and control improvements.
* Own CTI tooling configuration, alert set-up, monitoring and response, and feed intelligence into detection, hunting, vulnerability prioritisation and fraud use cases.
* Own enterprise vulnerability management and external attack surface management, including EASM configuration and inventory, prioritisation by exploitability and entity exposure, and remediation tracking with named owners and committed dates in partnership with technology owners.
* Provide technical leadership for Elastic Security, including log source onboarding, parsing and configuration, data ingestion, query development, dashboards, detection rules, integrations and platform optimisation. Ensure logging and telemetry across applications, APIs, endpoints, identity systems, networks, cloud platforms and third-party services provide the visibility required to detect and investigate activity.
* Own deployment, administration and lifecycle management of JSOC security solutions, including Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, ZDX) and email security, and evaluate and improve tools, integrations and workflows on measurable operational value.
* Direct security and fraud research and development within the JSOC, including AI-assisted triage and automation, in line with enterprise AI governance requirements. Apply change control and independent review before any internally built tooling enters production, maintaining segregation between building a control and monitoring it.
* Lead the DevSecOps team in SAST and DAST configuration, application vulnerability management and application security advisory, prioritised by regulated-entity exposure. Partner with engineering and platform teams to integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines, investigate application-layer threats and strengthen detection across the software development lifecycle.
* Support integrity investigations for Compliance, HR, Fraud and Legal under evidence-handling standards, and partner with Enterprise Fraud on account takeover, abuse and fraud-adjacent detection and response affecting online financial services.
* Define and monitor operational metrics including detection coverage, alert quality, time to detect and respond, investigation outcomes, recurring incident patterns and control gaps, and prepare quarterly executive and Board committee reporting content for the Global Security Office.
* Participate in and facilitate incident simulations, technical tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews, ensuring lessons result in concrete improvements to controls, detections and response procedures.
* Hire, coach, develop and manage the JSOC leadership layer and, through them, the wider team. Raise the team's technical depth, set clear expectations for investigation quality and operational ownership, and manage span of control, shift staffing and succession so that no service line depends on a single person.
* Partner with Cyber Strategy, Risk and GRC, Offensive Security, Identity and Access Management, Enterprise Fraud, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud and Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Internal Audit and entity compliance officers. Provide evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF and regulator reviews covering detection and response controls.
* Review complex technical findings and communicate business impact, evidence and recommended actions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive and Board committee audiences.
* Stay current with attacker techniques, application security risks, security operations practices, cloud-native security operations and technologies relevant to a Canadian regulated financial group.

**You're ready for this mandate if you have the following qualifications**

* 10+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial experience in security operations, incident response, detection engineering or threat hunting, with 5+ years leading technical security professionals and at least 2 years leading managers or team leads.
* Strong hands-on incident response experience, including investigation, scoping, containment, remediation, recovery and post-incident analysis, with major incident leadership in a regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrated experience running a 24x7 or follow-the-sun security operations function across multiple countries and shifts.
* Demonstrated experience conducting threat hunts and converting findings into durable detections or security improvements.
* Deep knowledge of SIEM operations, including alert development, query optimisation, data onboarding, false-positive reduction and detection coverage measurement.
* Strong practical experience with Elastic Security, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic Query Language (EQL) and Kibana Query Language (KQL), or equivalent query and detection capabilities.
* Solid understanding of application security concepts, including common web and API attack techniques, secure development practices, vulnerability management and application-layer telemetry.
* Strong knowledge of endpoint, network, identity, cloud and application security data sources, and the ability to analyse logs, network activity, authentication events, endpoint telemetry and application behaviour without relying solely on tool-generated conclusions.
* Experience with MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain, and with developing security automation, scripts, integrations or repeatable investigation workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risk clearly, make sound decisions in high-pressure situations and present to executive and Board committee audiences.
* A leadership style grounded in technical credibility, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement, with proven ability to build a leadership layer and manage span of control across a geographically distributed team.
* Experience in a regulated financial services environment such as banking, brokerage, wealth management, payments or fintech.
* CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, OSED, CPTS, Security+ or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with OSFI B-13, B-10 and E-21, OSFI technology and cyber security incident reporting expectations and CIRO cybersecurity incident reporting obligations, or demonstrated ability to learn a new prudential regime quickly.
* Deep expertise with Zscaler products, including ZIA, ZPA, ZDX and related integrations and telemetry.
* Familiarity with CrowdStrike Falcon, Wiz, Aikido and cloud-native security operations in Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider.
* Experience integrating security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines, and familiarity with SOAR platforms and AI-assisted triage and automation workflows.
* Experience investigating fraud, account takeover, abuse or other threats affecting online financial services.
* Experience with scripting or development in Python, JavaScript, Bash or another relevant language.

**Additional Information**

* Lead a globally distributed team operating a follow-the-sun model across Canada, Brazil, Armenia, Israel and Argentina, with shift-based SOC coverage (Shifts A, B and C) and flexible Eastern Time coverage.
* Working day anchored to the Toronto Eastern Time business day for executive, entity, auditor and regulator-facing engagement.

Title: Head of Data Science, Customer Technology
Description:
The Opportunity
  
  
We are hiring a Head of Data Science for Customer Technology, a large global organization responsible for Wayfair’s experience worldwide, across web and apps. This is a pivotal role, leading a large global team of 35-40 data scientists across the United States, Canada, and India. In this role, the data science agenda you and your team define will improve every step of the shopping journey, from inspiration to discovery, search, recommendations, product evaluation, and purchase. As AI is redefining what shopping means, this is a chance to shape this future, towards a more dynamic and conversational experience that provides the right information to the customer at the right moment to help them make confident decisions.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  
The Next Generation Shopping Journey
  
  
You will lead and evolve the data science strategy for the shopping journey from the front door through product discovery, intelligent comparison and product details, to pricing and purchase. You will shape our agentic strategy, deepening our understanding of how customers shop with agents, and innovating to anticipate and respond to changes in this consumer behavior as agentic usage grows. You will partner closely with leading AI companies to help Wayfair show up best wherever our customers are. You will advance experiences that go beyond finding the right product, to helping customers manage their homes with assembly, installation, white glove delivery, warranty and more.
  
  
Customer Inspiration & Lifecycle
  
  
In this role, you will advance what we know about customers from new experiences that help them visualize and design a space that feels like home. You will build a coherent strategy across their multimodal interactions from clicks, conversations, imagery, video, and more. You will deepen our understanding of customer intent to power personalized experiences that meet customers across their needs, preferences, and constraints.
  
  
Omni-channel
  
  
As Wayfair expands into physical retail, you will define the data science agenda to make the ecommerce and physical retail experience seamless and complimentary, by connecting what we know about customers, their propensity and intent, and behavior onsite and in the stores. This will extend beyond the products they find and how they pick them up, to how they leverage expert help, pay in the ways that are right for them, and be rewarded across their interactions.
  
  
AI-Enabled Development
  
  
You will embrace and leverage agentic development to accelerate innovation, reimagining the software development lifecycle from opportunity identification through validation and test, while meeting our standards on data quality, accuracy, and completeness. You will invest in AI to hold a high bar on rigor and quality of insights, scale self-service tools and workflows, and enable product teams to innovate for customers.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
You deliver innovations that meaningfully impact business outcomes. You make explicit choices about where the organization will-and will not-invest. You raise the bar on customer experience, the quality and pace of data science insights, self-service ability, and ROI. You build a strong leadership bench and an organization capable of meeting customer demand reliably, while modernizing our workflows, experiences, and systems.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
\*
  
  
Leadership in heading the data science function for a large, globally distributed organization responsible for customer-facing experiences and platforms.
  
\*
  
  
Deep consumer technology and sensibilities. Judgement and perspective from having built and operated consumer technology at scale.
  
\*
  
  
Technical credibility across several relevant areas, including customer behavior analytics, predictive modeling, advanced experimental design, and managing large, multi-year technology investments.
  
\*
  
  
A record of defining and executing a multi-year data science strategy across multiple business units and technical domains, with the judgement to simplify scope, sequence investments, and pivot when an approach is not producing sufficient value.
  
\*
  
  
**Strong organizational and executive leadership:** building senior talent, and connecting investments to customer and business impact.
  
  
Helpful Experience
  
  
Experience with statistical learning and analysis, predictive model building and evaluation, multi-brand or multi-region commerce, consumer shopping technology, personalization and recommendation platforms, privacy & fraud, cloud data and infrastructure, advanced experimentation methodologies.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
This role is based in Seattle, Mountain View, Toronto, or Boston. The organization and its partners are distributed across North America and India. Success requires deliberate presence with teams and leadership across locations, including periodic travel.
  
  
Why Wayfair
  
  
Home remains a complex, high-consideration category with enormous room for technology to improve how customers discover, evaluate, purchase, deliver, and install products. Wayfair operates at a scale where platform decisions have visible customer and commercial impact-and where agentic commerce is already moving from concept to live customer behavior.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to lead the insights that power today’s shopping experience while defining how Wayfair evolves to embrace new customer behavior and new technology trends.

Plans and directs activities for revenue growth, Profit and Loss (P&L) profitability, key business metrics and securing customer satisfaction while driving the implementation of corporate strategies. **Summary**
The Director of IT Operations leads the IT Service Desk and Field Services teams at Onvida Health, ensuring exceptional delivery of technology support and end-user services. This role oversees the adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and alignment with organizational needs. The Director leads IT Service Desk and Field Services operations across all Onvida Health locations, manages ServiceNow platform modules such as Incident, Request, Change, and Asset Management, develops and enforces IT support standards and escalation procedures, and drives continuous improvement and modernization initiatives. The role includes mentoring a high-performing team, managing vendor relationships for support tools and technologies, collaborating with clinical and business leaders to align IT services with broader goals, and serving as a key incident response leader during major service disruptions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Planning/Vision; Competency: a) Provides vision, forward thinking and strategic planning in a proactive manner while being open-minded and creative in establishing a strategic direction. b) Develops through an integration of ideas of those involved, an organized strategy to achieve both short and long term objectives for the department. Effectively communicates strategy to obtain commitment by the responsible individuals. Accountability: Leads the strategic planning process for the respective department. As plans are developed, these plans and objectives are integrated within the plans of the medical center. The incumbent works with others in leadership as well as physicians to identify and evaluate programs and emerging technologies. Leads the strategic planning process for IT Service Delivery, incorporating innovative ideas to enhance service quality and user satisfaction. Aligns the service delivery roadmap with Onvida Health’s broader strategic initiatives and emerging technologies like ServiceNow expansions.
  
  
Fiscal Management :Competency: a) Demonstrates a personal accountability for financial results through development of an annual budget and operational plan and management of performance based on plan. b) Engages staff in efforts to contain costs and improve the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of services. Understands the basics of health care financial management. Accountability: Establishes budget targets for department, provides oversight for the process, and holds self and other individuals accountable for compliance with annual budget plan. Develops and manages the operational budget for Service Desk and Field Services. Monitors expenses, optimizes resource utilization, and evaluates cost-saving measures including ServiceNow automation opportunities and vendor management. Identifies program or service growth opportunities and methodologies to enhance revenues. Able to manage a volume adjusted budget.
  
  
Customer Service; Competency: a) Exhibits unyielding commitment to providing excellent service to patients, physicians, employees and other customers. b) Demonstrates strong communication skills through effective exchange of information with others, including written and oral communication, active listening, influencing the behavior of others and building personal rapport. c) Communicates with others in an open and friendly manner, while simultaneously building credibility and rapport. d) Exhibits strong interactive skills through a demonstration of respecting others’ feelings, ideas and opinions; fosters an open interchange, displays a genuine understanding and acceptance of others. Demonstrates perceptivity regarding others’ feelings, ideas and opinions. Accountability: Responsible for assuring a respectful work environment. Promotes Patient & Family Centered Care. Sets the tone in the department by communicating values and attitudes that will significantly shape the culture of the group. Models appropriate behaviors and values; sets expectations for respectful behavior with all employees. Supports collaboration between patients, families, health care practitioners, and health care leaders in policy and program development, implementation, and evaluation; in facility design; professional education, and delivery of care. Sets a high standard for user experience by embedding a culture of exceptional customer service throughout Service Desk and Field Services teams. Leads initiatives that support Patient & Family Centered Care through technology reliability and responsiveness.
  
  
Operational Management / Quality in Everything We Do ;Competency: a) Exhibits a commitment to operational management and completing tasks through personal initiative, persistence. Demonstrates an ability to plan, organize, coordinate, prioritize, balance workload and follow through to achieve institutional and individual goals and objectives. b) Demonstrates use of good judgments and sound decision making (common sense, intuition, data collection, analytical skills, impact evaluation, communications) to systematically address problems, define alternate solutions, negotiate and facilitate implementation of solutions. c) Able to balance need for consensus and involvement with need for decisiveness and action. Provides consistent and open encouragement to trying new and creative approaches, yet willing to make a decision and take a stand. Contributes new ideas and new ways of thinking to improve departmental performance and services. Identifies need for change and develops/accepts creative approaches and solutions. Participates in performance improvement activities, and by challenging processes, eliminates inefficient/ineffective procedures and waste by collaborating with co-workers or across departments to improve processes. Implements an effective and on-going program to monitor, evaluate and improve the quality of services delivered. Accountability: With the assistance of direct reports, develops processes and procedures which are effective, efficient and aligned with organizational goals and values. Responsible for coordinating and integrating intra-hospital services. Ensures division has qualified staff and needed resources in order to deliver safe quality care and outcomes. Establishes performance standards with which to measure effectiveness and efficiency of services. Drives the establishment of performance metrics, service benchmarks, and quality assurance initiatives within IT Service Delivery. Implements continuous service improvement processes based on user feedback, data analytics, and ServiceNow reporting
  
  
System Thinking ;Competency: a) Ability to see how individual actions contribute to the overall good of the institution. Understands and is able to communicate how individual and department goals overlap with YRMC’s goals. b) Demonstrates commitment for the good of the organization while maintaining congruence with commitment to the department. c) Able to recognize and use information about organizational climate and key individuals to accomplish legitimate organizational goals. d) Aware of the importance of timing, politics and group processes in managing change. e) Able to balance department needs with the hospital needs. Skillful at reconciling the two without sacrificing the critical needs of either. Accountability: Works collaboratively with a variety of key stakeholders to achieve team, department and YRMC’s goals. Demonstrates an ability to align departmental goals with the larger vision of Onvida Health. Understands how IT Service Delivery operations impact clinical, operational, and administrative workflows across the organization.
  
  
Human Resources Management Competency: a) Able to develop others through setting clear expectations, mentoring and coaching, and holding others accountable for results. b) Utilizing work force analysis, identifies required competencies needed for effective management of human resources and is able to identify short and long-term staffing needs, c) Conducts oneself in an honest, credible, trustworthy manner consistent with YRMC’s values. Demonstrates an integration of values, beliefs, attitudes and behaviors through an acceptance of responsibility and accountability for individual’s own actions.
  
  
Accountability: Ensures that the work force has the necessary skills to accomplish the work required to achieve the objectives of the department. Partners with Human Resources to develop long-term human resource plans, anticipating future needs and developing employees able to meet those challenges. Fosters an open working environment for easy access to express ideas and concerns. Demonstrates and expects open communications. Promotes an environment that is open and collaborative while keeping the team focused on a common goal. Builds rapport, encourages teamwork, creates an environment where employees may feel empowered. Leads workforce development efforts by mentoring, coaching, and providing clear career progression pathways for Service Desk and Field Services staff. Partners with HR to forecast staffing needs based on service demands and future technologies.
  
  
Community ;Competency: a) Leverage the unique system capabilities (hospital and community providers) to increase value for external and internal customers and eliminate barriers to care. b) Participate in community involvement. c) Champion community involvement in the department and throughout the organization. Accountability: Promote and encourage community involvement throughout the department. Incorporate community goals in overall departmental goals. Demonstrate involvement in community events and hospital partnerships. Maintains appropriate continued education as it relates to the role.
  
  
**Education**
Essential:
  
  

* BACHELOR'S DEGREE

**Other Information**
Minimum Requirements
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field required. Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
7+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including 3+ years managing Service Desk or Field Services.
  
  
3+ years of experience configuring and optimizing ServiceNow platform modules.
